Peter — I’m not writing to be alarmist, but Trump has just made another move as part of his billionaire-first agenda. Today, Trump announced he is launching an investigation into ActBlue, which you likely recognize as the largest digital fundraising platform used by Democratic campaigns, advocacy organizations, and donors. While Trump and Republicans claim this investigation is to ensure that no foreign actors are participating in our elections, let’s be very clear about what this is: **an attempt to systematically undermine our democratic process. ** By limiting how and when grassroots supporters — supporters like you, Peter — can contribute, your ability to engage in our elections is greatly diminished. And by limiting how and when grassroots donations are received, Democratic candidates — like me and my House Democratic colleagues — lose our ability to reach as many voters as we can through on-the-ground organizing, direct voter outreach, and so much more. But it doesn’t limit the ability for billionaires like Elon Musk to cut million dollar checks to the corrupt, greedy, and cruel politicians who are willing to sell out their constituents to further their own power. #
Peter,
**The Trump administration’s executive action against ActBlue today is a blatant attempt to squash the power of everyday Americans.** Please let us explain.
The first thing you should know is that ActBlue is an online fundraising platform that allows millions of Americans to directly engage in our democracy. It revolutionized the way that campaigns and causes like ours are able to fundraise — giving us the ability to build huge grassroots movements with support from real people like you, just $5 or $25 at a time.
The second thing you should know is that this action isn’t _really_ about ActBlue.
**Trump and his allies are seeing in real time that grassroots supporters like you are using ActBlue to support pro-worker and pro-freedom candidates across the country.** They’re seeing that, in response to all the chaos and uncertainty they’ve caused over the last nearly-100 days, people like you are organizing to fight back in record numbers.
**And that makes them scared.**
They see evidence of Americans like you taking action in the public quarterly fundraising reports, which happen to have “ActBlue” listed on them. They see it in the town halls being held and the protests being attended by voters in red and blue states alike.
**So that’s the real reason they’re targeting ActBlue... to strip away power from everyday Americans like you.** They want to have complete control over your ability to be an active participant in our American democracy — _and we cannot afford to let them win._
**[Will you help us fight back in this critical moment by rushing a donation of $10 or just whatever makes sense for you right now? Peter,

When you think of living your day-to-day life, what do you picture?

Going to the supermarket?
Walking around your neighborhood?
Cooking yourself breakfast, lunch, and dinner?

**The government thinks someone like me only needs to get from their bedroom to the bathroom to live a full life.**

Yes, I'm serious: _**my bedroom to the bathroom.**_ That's it.

My name is Thomas Quiter, founder of the Mobility Independence Foundation (MIF). I was born with Osteogenesis Imperfecta and have required the use of a wheelchair for my entire life.

The government believes in the "in-the-home rule" when it comes to mobility equipment. This means that insurance companies are only required to provide mobility equipment for "daily living," _meaning the bedroom to the bathroom_.

**They believe that for me to have a full life, I don 't need to go outside or even throughout my entire home. **

_Not only that ..._

If there is normal wear and tear on a wheelchair from outside use, insurance won't cover the costs to fix it. Causing people to be trapped in their homes for months or even years with broken mobility equipment.

I founded MIF to revolutionize and deregulate mobility technology so we can provide impactful mobility solutions to those who need them most.

But I need your help.

[Could you donate $10, $35, $50, or even $100 to help the Mobility Independence Foundation fight government regulations like the inhumane "in-the-home rule?" Donate now >>](http://links.conservativeum.com/s/c/_E2o2q8jlnUQiAa1c6ElOF4rWUMcJt30uCZ0HQ8CW2fHbqjM4wRQylLmwk9kaGL3V_TtMJXZZtnGakxF1KGl--DkOjRClumRIDF42fFN9j18yedw0Xybm8eaZjkjbktH2bA45Wc7O_DL9-KNDldL1CIJxbI_tv1wOIIpOx1H-deWaFpOgrLQNVrcV_d7E6fbIZHWUyU5-bwjKrtrHtZ8EltFW7NibTvSHVYC6YQgMom7QC6cC1I0U8VqzaImuRDjEBhfVWxwRjSu2Fm178MFnNOvWoHHZO1BX1yX09uEG4kLs6C0TwrzTZXadQ09BINlyXipObRbZ-DydbMoei6FuHaAar0lnNTZr9VEck0HOz47dipqmRrVguS9b6KqakxxwYkbczFXWSmHdUrO2lTU7lDF6oBVd2zPqaDZPM7n_MKyKk5KN4wHOkfQFvj78F8iRd7z6gpfIbtUC5o_iG9HOJyql0L8fRpAGMLjAQCG8hdVvWzbKO6iEA/ADnKVCjrggjY4tGTf-LCB81_IQQZdUjX/8)

Government regulations don't stop at the "in-the-home rule."

Currently, the FDA considers wheelchairs the same as a prescription, and people are told they cannot modify or repair them.

**I was told I should discard a $65,000 custom wheelchair over a 2-inch part.** This is when I realized the importance of open-source mobility equipment in the industry.

Our local communities are far more capable of supporting each other as neighbors than the bureaucrats in Washington, D.C., ever will be. This is why our mission is to use open-source hardware rather than relying on government programs.

Under open source hardware:
* People have the right to repair
* We don't have to fight IP laws
* Communities can produce equipment themselves

It's critical we empower our communities to support one another rather than allow the government to dictate how we should live our lives.

clean_body: Peter, When you think of living your day-to-day life, what do you picture? Going to the supermarket? Walking around your neighborhood? Cooking yourself breakfast, lunch, and dinner? The government thinks someone like me only needs to get from their bedroom to the bathroom to live a full life. Yes, I'm serious: my bedroom to the bathroom. That's it. My name is Thomas Quiter, founder of the Mobility Independence Foundation (MIF). I was born with Osteogenesis Imperfecta and have required the use of a wheelchair for my entire life. The government believes in the "in-the-home rule" when it comes to mobility equipment. This means that insurance companies are only required to provide mobility equipment for "daily living," meaning the bedroom to the bathroom. They believe that for me to have a full life, I don 't need to go outside or even throughout my entire home. Not only that ... If there is normal wear and tear on a wheelchair from outside use, insurance won't cover the costs to fix it. Causing people to be trapped in their homes for months or even years with broken mobility equipment. I founded MIF to revolutionize and deregulate mobility technology so we can provide impactful mobility solutions to those who need them most. But I need your help. The focus of this book is on how ALL Americans can improve our country and our culture, starting with a focus on improving ourselves... Because winning back our country doesn 't start with politicians in D.C. or pundits on TV - it starts with you, me, and other like-minded grassroots patriots! Now, Peter, I want to get my new book in the hands of as many Americans as possible -- which is why I'm offering to send you a hardcover edition for FREE. Peter, the future of this movement depends on patriots like you who aren't afraid to stand up, speak out, and take action. We are taking back America and the next generation from the radical Left. And we're just getting started. So please, and I'll send you a FREE hardcover copy of** Right Wing Revolution as a personal thank you. Thank YOU for your patriotism, moral courage, and - in advance - your support of Turning Point USA. For America, Charlie KirkFounder & CEOTurning Point USA 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044 |

I’m proud to be a lifelong Michigander. I learned the value of hard work by watching my parents – who owned their own landscaping business – build things. Heavy machinery equipment, bobcats, plows, dirt, grease, and grime – it was all part of my childhood.
Later in life, I got the call to give back to the state I love during a time of great uncertainty: the Great Recession. **I can’t tell you how unfathomable it was to hear the words “bankruptcy” and "General Motors" in the same sentence.** So I stepped up to do my part and served as chief of staff for the Auto Rescue initiative under President Obama.
We brought workers, corporations, and union leadership around the same table to stabilize the auto industry. On Friday nights, I’d stay in the office until the late evening to return every call from every Michigander who called worried about the future. _In the end, we saved 200,000 Michigan jobs._
I can’t help but see parallels between then and now as we find ourselves in another moment of great uncertainty, thanks to the chaos forced on us by Donald Trump and his billionaire buddy Elon Musk.
People are rightly concerned about rising costs, shoot-from-the-hip tariffs, and attacks on our personal freedoms. **Michiganders need a fighter in their corner – and that’s who I’ve been my entire life. **

subject: White House pushes to strip federal funding from public media

body:
Use your voice to reject Trump’s agenda! >>

| **BREAKING:** The Trump administration will ask Congress to claw back more than $1 billion slated for public broadcasting in the U.S. later this month. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/106455786/541618985/-583442086?refcode=NDCAF_20250424_EMPET_E3_T0_AC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84Mjc1NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiN2JlMTQwNS03OTIxLWYwMTEtOGIzZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=glaN_1tFTtfW2mJudMYX1VrLB2-dPwKeLQijZGP1seI=&emci=d6f2d67f-3e21-f011-8b3d-0022482a9fb7&emdi=b7be1405-7921-f011-8b3d-0022482a9fb7&ceid=48524772) If the GOP-controlled Congress approves these cuts,**it could wipe out nearly all federal funding for trusted public outlets like NPR and PBS.**

#
---
From the desk of
---
# [James O'Keefe](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zfhdujoqcjndv90fa7ng49jtb0b74g058ud6ibk8_rp22sh2s8i6eob5cljmaoj5c3h2bs)
---
|
---
| | Dear Fellow Patriot, I risked my life to get this footage from the border. Jumping aboard a moving freight train filled with Venezuelan migrants in the dead of night... being detained by the Mexican national guard ... and even sneaking into a secret child encampment in Texas that housed unaccompanied children. **Anyone who has seen what I’ve seen and still resists****President Trump on securing the border, deporting criminal illegals, and designating cartels as foreign terrorist organizations is _leading_ _America_ _down_ _a_ _dangerous_ _path_.** That’s why I’m writing to you today with this personal request. [Will you click here to make your _**“LINE IN THE SAND” Emergency Contribution**_ in the next 48 hours? Help me and Tucker Carlson distribute this soul-wrenching documentary, fuel our other critical investigations, _and_ sound a clarion call to fix the gaping wound that is America’s immigration crisis.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zh0r2kn8ke07hvf88oglisbs5r8i0jlou8c9eg90_rp22sh2s8i6eob5cljmaoj5c3h2bs)
---

---
I interviewed border patrol agents who were extremely emotional and who clearly had reached their breaking point... not long after we came across a little girl standing alone in the desert in the middle of the night completely abandoned. This left me more convinced than ever that when it comes to the border, there are only two kinds of Americans. 1\. Those who _are_ outraged and already demanding it be secured; and 2\. Those who _will_ be outraged and demand it be secured once they come face to face with the threat posed by the 11.5 million migrants who illegally crossed our border over the last four years – a shocking 650,000 with criminal backgrounds (including 14,944 murders and 20,061 charged with sexual assault)
---
| | I traveled to this warzone. I saw with my own eyes. And I did all this so you wouldn’t have to. That’s exactly what this documentary has the power to do. Correction. That’s exactly what _you_ have the power to do. name: Hillsdale College via American Action News
subject: A free video series about Lewis and Tolkien
body:
C.S. Lewis and J.R.R. Tolkien wrote some of the twentieth century’s most beloved works of literature, including robust defenses of the Christian faith.

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zom6ef633n0elmknoa1e5ghu9av9ues55di8fasg_rp22sh2s8i6eob5cljm6p32cjh2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend,

C.S. Lewis and J.R.R. Tolkien wrote some of the twentieth century's most beloved works of literature, including robust defenses of the Christian faith.

Today, I want to share an exclusive and free video series with you that considers Lewis and Tolkien in the context of their membership in the Inklings--an informal professor-student literary group at Oxford in the 1930s and 40s.

**You can receive instant access to this free video series about the Inklings by using this secure link now:**

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/the-inklings-cca](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2za5okf7n6ncd9c5a92ir23546fttpmr8ad1ag63g_rp22sh2s8i6eob5cljm6p32cjh2bs)**

C.S. Lewis is best known for his Narnia books--such as _The Lion, the Witch, and the Wardrobe_ --and his apologetics, including _Mere Christianity_. Indeed, Lewis is one of the greatest Christian apologists of all time.

J.R.R. Tolkien's most renowned works are _The Hobbit_ and _The Lord of the Rings _trilogy.

That both were men of genius is indisputable. Both men also devoted countless hours to honing their craft. This included subjecting their writing to the scrutiny of their fellow Inklings, who met regularly for conversation and to read aloud from and discuss their current work.

**The Inklings are a fascinating topic of study, which is why we 've created a free online video series for you to enjoy. **

The video series, titled "The Inklings," was filmed on the Hillsdale College campus. It examines the ideas that bound the Inklings, what they accomplished, and the continuing importance of their works today--with a special focus on Lewis and Tolkien.

**You can use the secure link below to receive instant access to "The Inklings" free video series:**

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/the-inklings-cca](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zhilhf2lpjvmt0qgll8vlh31s6b2ie8b6iu5p5s0_rp22sh2s8i6eob5cljm6p32cjh2bs)**

Lewis and Tolkien thought the Inklings' meetings contributed significantly to their literary success. As models of civil discussion and intelligent debate, they stand in stark contrast to today's "cancel culture."

The Inklings, are therefore, worth studying not only for their great literary achievements but also because they exemplify the free speech that is essential to the pursuit of truth.

That's why Hillsdale College created a free online video series on the Inklings. I hope you'll use the secure link above and start watching it today.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

P.S. C.S. Lewis and J.R.R. Tolkien met regularly with an informal literary group named the Inklings.

Now, you can examine the philosophical, theological, and literary ideas that bound the Inklings together with a free video series from Hillsdale College.

**You can receive instant access to this free video series about the Inklings using this secure link:**

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/the-inklings-cca](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zaga0dra58m9rc7pftrnrn2qb0cdcgmer9o5tflo_rp22sh2s8i6eob5cljm6p32cjh2bs)**

name: Kirk Cameron
subject: Bring wholesome messaging back to children’sentertainment
body:
Please – for the sake of all our families

| | | You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.
---
| |
---
| | Dear Friend in Faith,Please – for the sake of all our families – take it from me as someone who’s lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life... You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with “entertainment” that grooms children.You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace.But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue’s Clues_...
---
[](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z9uava5s91bs2a0al7urls9f3u57juag3qvsa8ro_rp22sh2s8i6eob5cljm1o71c3h2bs)
---
| | Or Sesame Street using YOUR tax-dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses.And the result is an upside-down world where children lecture YOU about what you can and cannot say... ...and they try to “educate” YOU about your “old-fashioned” and “mean” ideas.Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. **[Today, I’m inviting you to be a Founding Supporter of the very first children’s television show that actively fights back against the groomers in Hollywood AND reinforces the traditional biblical values that made America great.](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zp5a4feg3tpvj097dp7fd68ig517dnr5n90dd9mo_rp22sh2s8i6eob5cljm1o71c3h2bs)** Introducing: _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.I’m making this ground-breaking live-action television show with the great folks at **Brave Books**.If you’ve seen me and **Brave Books** on _Fox News_ , you know we’ve already countered those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” the Left has been pushing on children in our taxpayer funded libraries. Thanks to support from parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens just like you, we started hosting Godly and patriotic “Story Hours” of our own.And now, THOUSANDS of children and parents can gather to pledge allegiance to our flag, read wholesome books, and pray together in their libraries.It’s encouraging to see we can win when we fight back! Now we’re working to have that same impact in television.
---
>> Imagine a children's show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of truth.Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. >> Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart.>> Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. Because we can’t beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a **Founding Supporter**.
---
The great news is that we’ve already completed and released the first ten character-building episodes of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_! We premiered it recently to a small group of children and parents and I wish you could have seen the smiles on those innocent little faces.And I wish you could have experienced _the parents_ watching their children absorb the beautiful Gospel messages.It was quite a moment for everyone – including folks just like you – who worked so hard to get us that far. But now **Brave Books** has an urgent two-fold problem that I hope you can help with.
---
_**#1. Brave Books needs to launch a massive advertising blitz to get around the groomers on the Left.**_
---
You see, we’ve made the first five episodes of Season 1 of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ available absolutely FREE. That’s the best way we can reach MILLIONS of families with our Gospel-inspired messaging.But no one will see it if we can’t get the word out. And the Left will try to bury _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ at every turn. The price tag for an advertising blitz of this magnitude is $250,000 – and with the recent launch, we need to raise the funds immediately.
---
_**#2. We must complete Season 2 to keep our momentum going and that cost is $250,000 for post production.**_
---
I know that’s a lot of money but it’s actually a fraction of what it would cost if we made our show with a major Hollywood studio. And obviously, we won’t work through Hollywood.Hollywood has done quite enough already to destroy American culture and hijack our children.We parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens must take over to rebuild a thriving, healthy, GOOD and GODLY culture. **[That’s why I’m asking you to please contribute $35, $50, $250, $500, $2,500 or more to help us reach our fundraising goal of $250,000 for advertising and $250,000 for Season 2.](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zgjd5k27vq0cmq80hp9tse6tgfvrel9e7aautm18_rp22sh2s8i6eob5cljm1o71c3h2bs) ** As our special “Thank You” for becoming a **Founding Supporter** at the $50 level, we’ll send you all ten episodes of Season 1 of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ FREE on DVD.This exclusive _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ DVD is only offered to **Founding Supporters**. It won’t be available for sale anywhere. So with **[**your gift of $50**](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z76c3jnqad4c60hfu9v41dt7b4nncpucmsmbn5f8_rp22sh2s8i6eob5cljm1o71c3h2bs)** , you’ll be part of a small select group of people who own our wholesome TV show on DVD. You’ll have it ready to watch with the children in your life. Or you can drop your DVD by your local school, church, mission, or even leave it in the waiting room at your doctor’s office. So many children have no way of hearing God’s message in their lives. Your random act of kindness may change a child’s life. **[So please – whether you can send $50, $5,000, $25,000, or anything higher or lower, please respond quickly and know that gifts of EVERY size are needed and greatly appreciated.](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z2g61g2o27k1g7i4jtu2qf9letb7dg4guf1q9d2g_rp22sh2s8i6eob5cljm1o71c3h2bs)** There’s no time to waste. Hollywood groomers have destroyed America’s Godly culture. But today we rebuild from the ashes.And it starts by ensuring the most innocent among us are filled with faith and family – not filth.Thank you for being a part of history by becoming a **Founding Supporter** of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.
---
Sincerely,

name: Hillsdale College via Your America News
subject: For anyone who loves great literature
body:
C.S. Lewis and J.R.R. Tolkien wrote some of the twentieth century’s most beloved works of literature, including robust defenses of the Christian faith.

This sponsored message from Your American News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zg9aga8hgbkbuuaimnvd56ugp6ovub1bt3mj8ht8_rp22sh2s8i6eob5cljm9pr4chh2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend,

C.S. Lewis and J.R.R. Tolkien wrote some of the twentieth century's most beloved works of literature, including robust defenses of the Christian faith.

Today, I want to share an exclusive and free video series with you that considers Lewis and Tolkien in the context of their membership in the Inklings--an informal professor-student literary group at Oxford in the 1930s and 40s.

**You can receive instant access to this free video series about the Inklings by using this secure link now:**

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/the-inklings-cca](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zamk8c3l8lfs9nk7g90tr66foh6i8qq7vd6mgeag_rp22sh2s8i6eob5cljm9pr4chh2bs)**

C.S. Lewis is best known for his Narnia books--such as _The Lion, the Witch, and the Wardrobe_ --and his apologetics, including _Mere Christianity_. Indeed, Lewis is one of the greatest Christian apologists of all time.

J.R.R. Tolkien's most renowned works are _The Hobbit_ and _The Lord of the Rings _trilogy.

That both were men of genius is indisputable. Both men also devoted countless hours to honing their craft. This included subjecting their writing to the scrutiny of their fellow Inklings, who met regularly for conversation and to read aloud from and discuss their current work.

**The Inklings are a fascinating topic of study, which is why we 've created a free online video series for you to enjoy. **

The video series, titled "The Inklings," was filmed on the Hillsdale College campus. It examines the ideas that bound the Inklings, what they accomplished, and the continuing importance of their works today--with a special focus on Lewis and Tolkien.

**You can use the secure link below to receive instant access to "The Inklings" free video series:**

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/the-inklings-cca](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2ztbdrg8toaq15i9h8farhilb1fg4g86rnra9d0to_rp22sh2s8i6eob5cljm9pr4chh2bs)**

Lewis and Tolkien thought the Inklings' meetings contributed significantly to their literary success. As models of civil discussion and intelligent debate, they stand in stark contrast to today's "cancel culture."

The Inklings, are therefore, worth studying not only for their great literary achievements but also because they exemplify the free speech that is essential to the pursuit of truth.

That's why Hillsdale College created a free online video series on the Inklings. I hope you'll use the secure link above and start watching it today.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

P.S. C.S. Lewis and J.R.R. Tolkien met regularly with an informal literary group named the Inklings.

Now, you can examine the philosophical, theological, and literary ideas that bound the Inklings together with a free video series from Hillsdale College.

**You can receive instant access to this free video series about the Inklings using this secure link:**

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/the-inklings-cca](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zagnq8jsrv2c0bboc2u2a9513r9cebvvrnmotjmg_rp22sh2s8i6eob5cljm9pr4chh2bs)**

| I’m proud to be a lifelong Michigander. I learned the value of hard work by watching my parents – who owned their own landscaping business – build things. Heavy machinery equipment, bobcats, plows, dirt, grease, and grime – it was all part of my childhood. Later in life, I got the call to give back to the state I love during a time of great uncertainty: the Great Recession. I can’t tell you how unfathomable it was to hear the words “bankruptcy” and “General Motors” in the same sentence. We brought workers, corporations, and union leadership around the same table to stabilize the auto industry. On Friday nights, I’d stay in the office until the late evening and return every call from every Michigander who called our office worried about the future. In the end, we saved 200,000 Michigan jobs. I can’t help but see parallels between then and now as we find ourselves in another moment of great uncertainty, thanks to the chaos forced on us by Donald Trump and his billionaire buddy Elon Musk. name: History Facts
subject: Who is the real Charlie Brown?
body:
In 1950, a Minnesota art teacher granted permission for his co-worker, budding cartoonist Charles Schulz, to use his name for a character in a new comic strip.
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?xtl=1krv9cfc69ofiw3ycxi29sgoh5mwyezbo1een4hzwfqt04kpqcwviqpe5f5rerbzbk74c02avz6whh097hre5pdjwzo847ir137lbatfya9hfkdpuguefk0twenu01ippylyms6z11tzq2627dv71lltq&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sv9r9u&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)

# [Charlie Brown is named after a real person.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sv9r9u&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [Arts & Culture](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sv9r9u&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sv9r9u&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| I n 1950, a Minnesota art teacher [granted permission](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sv9r9u&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) for his co-worker, budding cartoonist Charles Schulz, to use his name for a character in a new comic strip. Taken aback by a sample drawing of the character, Charlie Brown asked, "Can't you make him look a little more like Steve Canyon or Superman?"
---
Indeed, the soon-to-be-famous child protagonist of _Peanuts_ looked nothing like the godlike Superman, and he also bore little resemblance to the young man who lent his name to the endeavor. Brown, a teacher at Art Instruction Schools in Minneapolis, did not sport a prominently bald head, nor did he own a wardrobe of zigzag-patterned shirts. Furthermore, unlike the sometimes sullen character who drew the ire of peers, the real Charlie Brown was outgoing and well liked.
Yet the flesh-and-blood version insisted there were more similarities to the pencil-and-ink creation than initially seemed, as his cheerful exterior masked a deep-seated insecurity. "Like Charlie Brown, when I get distressed or depressed I go into bed and pull the covers over my head," he told the _St. Paul Pioneer Press_ in 1979. "I've been known to stay there three or four days."
Brown wasn't the only Art Instruction Schools employee to see their name surface in _Peanuts_ , as fellow teachers Linus Maurer and Frieda Rich had their monikers incorporated into the strip, too. There was also a petite [redheaded](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sv9r9u&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) woman in the accounting department named Donna Mae Johnson, who dated Schulz long enough to consider a marriage proposal from the cartoonist, before running off with another suitor. While a "Donna" never appeared in _Peanuts_ , the specter of the heartbreak frequently returned in the form of shy Charlie Brown's unrequited love interest, the mysterious Little Red-Haired Girl... [Continue reading →](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sv9r9u&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)

## Charles Schulz created other comic strips after "Peanuts."
From 1947 into 1950, Charles Schulz drew the weekly cartoon series [_Li'l Folks_](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sv9r9u&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com), essentially a _Peanuts_ prototype with (nonrecurring) children characters and a dog that resembled Snoopy. But Schulz developed other comics, too — even after hitting it big with _Peanuts_. _It's Only a Game_ , a strip syndicated from late 1957 into early 1959, revolved around the [foibles](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sv9r9u&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) of adults competing in activities such as golf, bowling, and bridge; although credited solely to Schulz, much of the artwork was delegated to his old Art Instruction Schools colleague Jim Sasseville. Additionally, Schulz churned out a single-panel strip titled _Young Pillars_ from 1956 to 1965. [Created](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sv9r9u&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) for _Youth_ , a religious magazine, _Young Pillars_ featured the artist's telltale sketching and wit, albeit with jokes coming from wholesome teenagers who were devoted to the tenets of a church-centered life.

Taken aback by a sample drawing of the character, Charlie Brown asked, "Can't you make him look a little more like Steve Canyon or Superman?" Indeed, the soon-to-be-famous child protagonist of Peanuts looked nothing like the godlike Superman, and he also bore little resemblance to the young man who lent his name to the endeavor. Brown, a teacher at Art Instruction Schools in Minneapolis, did not sport a prominently bald head, nor did he own a wardrobe of zigzag-patterned shirts. Furthermore, unlike the sometimes sullen character who drew the ire of peers, the real Charlie Brown was outgoing and well liked. Yet the flesh-and-blood version insisted there were more similarities to the pencil-and-ink creation than initially seemed, as his cheerful exterior masked a deep-seated insecurity. "Like Charlie Brown, when I get distressed or depressed I go into bed and pull the covers over my head," he told the St. Paul Pioneer Press in 1979. "I've been known to stay there three or four days." Brown wasn't the only Art Instruction Schools employee to see their name surface in Peanuts , as fellow teachers Linus Maurer and Frieda Rich had their monikers incorporated into the strip, too. There was also a petite woman in the accounting department named Donna Mae Johnson, who dated Schulz long enough to consider a marriage proposal from the cartoonist, before running off with another suitor. While a "Donna" never appeared in Peanuts , the specter of the heartbreak frequently returned in the form of shy Charlie Brown's unrequited love interest, the mysterious Little Red-Haired Girl... | By clicking a link in this email, you're agreeing to our and . From 1947 into 1950, Charles Schulz drew the weekly cartoon series , essentially a Peanuts prototype with (nonrecurring) children characters and a dog that resembled Snoopy. But Schulz developed other comics, too — even after hitting it big with Peanuts. It's Only a Game , a strip syndicated from late 1957 into early 1959, revolved around the of adults competing in activities such as golf, bowling, and bridge; although credited solely to Schulz, much of the artwork was delegated to his old Art Instruction Schools colleague Jim Sasseville. Additionally, Schulz churned out a single-panel strip titled Young Pillars from 1956 to 1965. for Youth , a religious magazine, Young Pillars featured the artist's telltale sketching and wit, albeit with jokes coming from wholesome teenagers who were devoted to the tenets of a church-centered life. | **Before we dive in, I want to take a moment to thank the true Connecticut patriots who stood shoulder to shoulder with me throughout this six-year journey—one that has brought us to the brink of real accountability and change.**
This victory is not mine alone. It belongs to every person who believed in the importance of exposing this issue and fought to bring it into the light.
To **Chris Coyle** , Chairman of the Pomfret RTC—your commitment from day one has been nothing short of heroic. I could not have asked for a better partner in this mission.To **Mary Ann Turner** , our tireless State Party Vice Chair, thank you for your unwavering support.To **Jackie Homan** of the _Connecticut Sentinel_ , thank you for your fearless reporting and journalistic integrity.To Anne **Manusky** and the CTRA, your persistence kept the flame burning.To **Leora Levy** , RNC Chairwoman—thank you for opening doors in D.C. that helped elevate this cause to the national stage.And to **Gary Byron** , whose **megaphone** gave this issue a voice, and kept it echoing across Connecticut—thank you.
Achievements like these are never the work of one person. They are the product of unity, resolve, and belief in something bigger than ourselves.
So I ask you, my fellow Americans, as we stand on the precipice of justice...
**Are you tired of winning yet?**

|

| **News Flash | Act Blue Takedown**
President Donald Trump will sign a presidential memorandum Thursday launching an **investigation into ActBlue for potentially illegal methods of fundraising for Democrats,**
The Daily Signal has learned.
The memo directs Attorney General Pam Bondi to investigate and take appropriate action concerning allegations regarding the use of online fundraising platforms to make “straw” or “dummy” contributions and to make foreign contributions to U.S. political candidates and committees.
**ActBlue is currently under congressional investigation for alleged laundering of foreign money.**
The Daily Signal depends on the support of readers like you. Donate nowFederal Election Commission records show that in recent elections, some elderly Americans made thousands of small donations to Democrat fundraising political committees through ActBlue, The Daily Signal previously reported.
Individuals may have made numerous donations through ActBlue without their consent or knowledge that their names, addresses, and money were being used for these donations, Rep. Claudia Tenney, R-N.Y., co-chair of the Election Integrity Caucus, told The Daily Signal.
The presidential memorandum notes that a congressional investigation revealed significant fraud schemes using ActBlue and, over a 30-day period during the 2024 election cycle, hundreds of ActBlue donations from foreign IP addresses using prepaid cards, despite it being illegal for foreign nationals to contribute to U.S. elections.ActBlue came under fire on Oct. 29 because of its donor-verification policies. In a letter that day to ActBlue, **House Administration Committee Chairman Bryan Steil, R-Wis., said foreign actors from Iran, Russia, Venezuela, and China could use the platform to launder illicit money for use in U.S. political campaigns.**
The Democratic fundraising platform admitted in 2023 to Steil that it didn’t require contributors to use a card verification value, or CVV, to donate on its website with a credit card. Those security codes are meant to ensure that the person making a purchase physically possesses the credit card. The memo instructs Bondi to report the results of the investigation to Trump through the Counsel to the President.
ActBlue may have raked in millions through fraudulent donations, according to the testimonies of elderly Americans who said federal election records do not reflect their giving, The Daily Signal has reported.
**Eighteen registered Democrats in Connecticut, all over the age of 70, appear to have donated $1.9 million to Democratic causes, including ActBlue, through hundreds of thousands of small donations from 2016 to 2024, according to a review of Federal Election Commission filings by Dominic Rapini, cybersecurity company CEO and a former Connecticut Republican candidate for office.**
Curious about the donation patterns, **Rapini tracked down some of the Connecticut residents and asked them if they really did make thousands of small donations, sometimes multiple in a day, through ActBlue.**
Several of the supposed donors told Rapini they did not make any of the reported donations, nor did they know anything about how their names were being used, Rapini told The Daily Signal.
ActBlue did not immediately respond to The Daily Signal’s request for comment about the forthcoming investigation.
ActBlue CEO and President Regina Wallace-Jones sent an email to Democrats on Wednesday warning about rumors of the executive order.
“The current strategy of distraction and exhaustion is effective. We see this across the country and are not immune to this ourselves,” her email said, according to Punchbowl News. “The flow-on effect from the initial innuendo of the EO caused many in the ecosystem anxiety and distress.”

| | | | [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/3527892/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
| Trump and his Republican allies in Congress are rapidly advancing a tax bill that could repeal historic clean energy credits that are key to reducing pollution and keeping household costs down.

**The result will be devastating for red and blue states alike** , where investments in clean energy are growing rapidly. Will you call your members of Congress right now about the importance of defending these critical investments? [CALL YOUR REPS](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/3527893/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| Hi—

Right now, Congress is in recess. With representatives at home in their districts for just a few more days, they need to hear from you—**their constituents.** And we must keep up the pressure on them to protect critical clean energy programs in their sweeping $5.7 trillion tax package, which could be voted on as soon as they return.

Because if we don’t, we could see devastating rollbacks to clean energy tax credits, job-creating incentives, and programs that help Americans save on their energy bills—**all programs that voters overwhelmingly support.**

Every Republican needs to feel the heat for planning to repeal these historic investments and the hundreds of thousands of local jobs that come along with them—just to fund massive tax giveaways for billionaires. And every Democrat needs to know that we need them to continue to fight back to protect everyday Americans.

**Will you take a few minutes right now to call your representatives in Congress about protecting clean energy tax credits in the budget bill?**[**We’ve made it extra easy to connect with their offices, and have a sample script for you to use.**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/3527894/87SdQ4wZ) |
---
[CALL YOUR MEMBERS OF CONGRESS](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/3527895/87SdQ4wZ)

---
| With tariffs sending the economy into a tailspin and people already struggling to keep up with everyday costs, there are proven ways to keep energy bills and other costs from rising—with the clean energy investments we fought hard for and won, not the massive $5.7 trillion tax giveaway Trump and his Republican cronies want to hand to billionaires and corporations.

Americans want these investments protected, but need to make our voices heard to keep them off the chopping block. [**So please, friend—take a few minutes right now to call your representatives about what’s at stake if we lose these critical clean energy programs.**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/3527896/87SdQ4wZ) |

## 2022-23 School Ratings Released
The Texas Education Agency (TEA) [released its A-F campus ratings](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkbGunTAMhp8GNl8FQ4AzMHRhu107IpMYsBSSI2Luubx9xWnVF-hi_bIt-_fnX5_TJ0mQuP6knQf9XtIU-ZUDq_IxZbelFA5SiWtW_qbs08oU_YQGLZgG0E6eJFxTU_phNv5RlTxUXWNt1_cPW24DeW4Xa6u-7ZfOLX3_aK0jfNSOfUMtlzLcw0yDtqpMVZsPrObaYYfc1W4m0xeNYS-ajg_d-O1iCVf64uPDpb0Mw6b6zEX9o8CxwNGlfT-j6CX7k5zePQWOdGaVWOCY06kbOI56UIB_afanI5V069tOgaNpbn2H905YaJcgnMFRhJheQM5xzoAGEbAGggX-ALsr6YxKswTRC_4CBFqUD9jPoHIxHRB4pQAzqQYucCyPwT9fEoLktisas-4k4X2j_t9nvgb8HQAA__-Y6KWs) for the 2022-23 school year yesterday, marking the first time in five years that complete scores for Texas public schools have been published. Ratings in recent years were blocked or limited due to litigation and the COVID-19 pandemic. An appeals court [cleared the way](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkEHO2yAQRk-DdxPBAHGy8CJS5d3fXdWlNTZDjETgF5A4vn0VtzfobqSRPr33fn9NXxRiSPef9OChvX2eEm81cmtcprqsOcdCLaR7bfym6vKdKbkJJVqQBtBOjkLcJ9O5YZbuqjoeVG-s7S-Xq-3WwTp_7Xtz1tYoqa3kq1HaeU0XOVuF5y4MnzFp0CollZYnVLNesEfu9TKTvAgj2YWWy6mtfFD4uOcXl9OSH10c1ta-q9A3gaPAcdu206Omz0_gyAmeVeD4kRI4HndjqpC9D0ugCChRAy1LfqZGc4ih7fDPGKgw-JAoxh3ys8HKhSuseYMDA_72qeCpsBM4UoHbTf3Y5ftXVwb3vYUYQz33wsj7g0I8gNv_ZX4N-CcAAP__98iS0g) for the 2022-23 ratings to be released earlier this month. Of the 8,539 public schools evaluated, 19.3% got an A, 33.6% got a B, and 24.7% got a C. The number of schools earning an F [increased 233%](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO6yAURL8Gd1hwjR92QRHpycVK2TalBebaRsIQARviv18lu3-w9YxGZ87tOl-18y5sn_pAVZ5rnAPW7LEUTHNe9hh90sWFLRd86mzjhjrYGRj0lAkK_Wy18-csGqsMsyNvUHEp-l4Ow9g3u-JskWIwRozGdNBbqcFIPS525eNq1rFx6jXGBPScM96xFrjpFpCAsluMZgMRDK0rMbVlxzfF6s_4wNQu8Wi82ku5Z9JdCEwEplpre-TwyghMGOhXJjAdMeBJYIplx_Rq7SfNOlAdSgwu0p-n1LpckltKphUTUhtr2JK2aKkLNGClvy4ITDrRy4X_Pz_CrUnK3qvz3uV_kgi2Hdr5N1z5m9KHgu8AAAD__wBkjdo) compared to the previous release. The ratings are determined by students’ state test scores, college and career readiness, and improvement over time. Fort Worth ISD is [at risk of being taken over](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkMGK5CAQhp_G3Gy01E764KFhyW12jwt7CRWtdGRMHLR20vP2S5p9g7kVFHx8__f7bXrDlNP--IkbeX4uZdrpaJmYqU4trKXkipz2R2N6YovlQbjHCRQ4qawEN0VM-WuyXfSzijfdkde9da4fhpvrVh_64eauMwV3NQais04b4xQGDIRzHLrkT5iy4LRW2qgL6NkE6IF6E2ZUg7CKYuJSL7zSy2LJX-WT6iWUrct-Zf5owtwFjALG4zguW9vPn4CRdvm3CRjPUQLG172UyvIolVeZWpTIsqb2LpdSZWNkkozvdPIlLkxVggIj_0eQlTJhoyhgxCrvd_3j-cv-6aqPH0fKObVrL6x6bJjyS4-_F_XTw78AAAD__92ZjLI) by a state-appointed board due to multiple years of poor performance.
## Texas DOGE Established
Governor Greg Abbott signed the first bill of this year’s legislative session on Wednesday, creating a [Texas version](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2uozAUhJ8GOiNjcEwKF9vQ3W23RP45GEvGJ7JPILz9irzCrUcz-r7597P8mJhiDn_NDpo-Ky4ZzpqACMpS3YaYiqGYQyX4mOoxgMl-EVxIxkcm5OJNTNcytl5b7p99C7pXo5Rqmp6y3TQ8VqeMM-ohJ6uclMKp_smFl9yOg5Nt1PcYH4Xse94PvBO9HZxQAtTgrOFTM3LwkbB0tMGXYk0XHlA6h3ub9Eb0qs3wpxFzI-bzPLsVP7fFnTdifmGKFF1txPxtM1fAEFQWqTI8Mzug1IiZ3XIs4MFCgcCMtUjEqrkqKxDeyRCWi0E-YsG8QyZGiMy-i4dccYe2aP86Y0qxPlQz8rCbmL6M9LtnDy3-BwAA___hTZLD) of the Elon Musk-led federal DOGE initiative. Senate Bill 14 establishes the [Texas Regulatory Efficiency Office](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L-urCAQx_GnwY4NDKBYUNzGbm97SoMwCgnKRib75-1P3Fc49SSfzPf3c5_vPpd8bP_9jo7ea50PfLWCRHjOLaRay-kpH1sjfPsW64b-iDMIMFxoDmaOPpfPrLvoFhFH2aGTgzZmsHY0XXLS2nUZerGaKPteCQhhHJVerLBKj37psrswocFIKaQSN5CLCjAADiosXlimBcZM9bxRwu8Xa_nUJ563UPeuuET0aEz9YzAxmChhyqVcNwZTqjteQQymRp6QvzyFxGAy0KtRWP71uI_1QY1fddxveIQPg6k7XXy8cim59QPTYtt9_rod_W2pp4PfAAAA___B3ny-) as an executive branch advisory council. Its responsibilities include identifying “unnecessary and ineffective rules,” streamlining government operations, and providing increased public access to regulatory information. The legislation also clarifies that courts are [not required to defer to state agencies](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGypCAURL9GMyy8gGhAsInZbLqhhXJRqhiYgrvjzN-_0l94eVf3Of3vsTxsiCHtf-0TDX18XhKeNSIRlqVuR86xWAppr4QfW13e0Sa3AAfFuGSgFmdD_C6ydWblbupbNL2WSulxnFR7GCm5HycvBlRi0iNKP-CEaMWgpO69aoO5yrgE1fe8F7yDfhUbaEAtttXysZEcXaBcOjrwpvDxm99Yui0_22gOoldtxJ8G5gbm8zy7arf_pWCiK9HAfCk1MNt1zUSshj1V5kOpxNYQI8ueVaw15MRCosyiPdlW8NZmlt2T7DJnQgsAzaEtxr3OEGOog24k3582xBuHfnfi28BPAAAA__-c1YfA) in the interpretation of a statute and associated regulations, following the Supreme Court’s overturning of the longstanding Chevron doctrine last year. “ _There’s low-hanging fruit all over the place_ ,” [Abbott said](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO6yAURL_G7rDgGgIuKF6TLq_d0rqYi42WmMiwIfn7lfML24_OzJmv23zDmOK-_sc72foKed6plUS10jGXZcs5HVjjvpZKLyw-r4S7n4GDYlwyULPHmN6z7L113E-iJyu0VEobM6l-syTRmRH9JXjuBQYTpimAcRN6HQyGPtoTxiUoIbgY-QDCjQtoID0uDrnpJCcfaz6GutFnRUjv_KRjWPK9T3ar9VG68V8H1w6urbXhVGhE32egg-t60MrQuVwrS_izLxsV9gGx04cBv4xKm_6w_tFiSrFcdCf5eseYPh31b888LfwGAAD__zXNeYQ). “ _When you look at the vast amount of regulations, there’s so much slicing and dicing that needs to be done_.”

body:
Before you do anything else today, will you please take a moment to sponsor a gift for our “See You at the Library Day” in the next 48 hours?

| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zaonsi6ap48t0lb7q8auq49vqobmnd20n14kulq0_rp22sh2s8i6eob5clieepr2c3h2bs)

| | Fellow Conservative,Before you do anything else today, will you please take a moment to **[sponsor a gift for our “See You at the Library Day” in the next 48 hours?](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z39kojbvh0fs35mudbgofcaep1b0skcti3cgp1lg_rp22sh2s8i6eob5clieepr2c3h2bs)** If you haven’t heard about the “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, please let me tell you why it’s so critical.
---
Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian. She would fill your mind with classics like _Pat the Bunny_ and _The Little Engine That Could_. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the _Three Musketeers_ , _Treasure Island_ and _Charlotte’s Web_.But today, all that has changed.The president of the American Library Association (ALA) is a self-described “Marxist lesbian.”Radical librarians call _Adventure of Huckleberry Finn_ and _To Kill a Mockingbird_ “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic” _Little House_ series.And they bring men in wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... A is for Activist. An ABC board book for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for...”

Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood.But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian.When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action. So together with a small Christian book publisher aptly named **Brave Books** , I wrote “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit.And then we decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with a wholesome Story Hour of our own. HB 1586 by Representative Lacey Hull would allow Texans to print Reasons of Conscience Affidavits at home, streamlining the process to exempt themselves or their children from vaccination requirements. HB 4076 by Representative Jeff Leach would prohibit the denial of organ transplantation based solely on the organ recipient’s vaccination status. body:
| | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/106480372/541669368/623074613?refcode=jtk1402-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM3OTQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNWU3MmVmOTUtZGQyMS1mMDExLThiM2QtNjA0NWJkZWQ4Y2NhIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=mW7QRfiIxTX-vQQv7yVYmLvW4n0T-lHoIBoNMCypZhM=&emci=01be876f-3c21-f011-8b3d-0022482a9fb7&emdi=5e72ef95-dd21-f011-8b3d-6045bded8cca&ceid=9329426)
---
Friend,

I just know that our nation's Founding Fathers are turning in their graves.
Nearly 250 years after American independence from tyrannical rule, the sitting president of the United States, Donald Trump, is acting every bit the tyrant.
Issuing blizzards of executive decrees, even as the checks and balances of our court system try to rein in his unlawful behavior, Trump ignores rulings from federal courts – even from the Supreme Court, the highest in our land – more or less proclaiming himself king.
Trump's steamrolling over our Constitution and the rule of law has real-life consequences. One need look no further than the mega-prison in El Salvador, where Trump and his team wrongly deported a Maryland man, admitting it was an administrative error. Kilmar Armando Abrego Garcia – a husband, a father to three children, and a sheet metal apprentice – was just taken. With no proper charges filed, no hearing, no legal representation. He remains a prisoner in a facility notorious for its human rights abuses, without ever having been charged with a crime by the United States or El Salvador. Federal judges have ruled against the administration’s unlawful hijacking. The Supreme Court of the United States has ruled 9-0 against it. And yet Trump continues resisting the Supreme Court's orders to facilitate Kilmar's return.

**_If this can happen to one resident, what does it portend about our rights and due process for the rest of us?_**
Trump's crackdown and forced disappearances of migrants are alarming enough in their own right. But it's being matched by his retribution campaign against universities and the nonprofit sector at large – using the threatened denial of promised federal funding to force institutions to bend to his will and radical ideals. He's even weaponizing the IRS against his personal enemies, while his administration seeks to ease IRS pressure on Trump friend, ally, and pillow-guy, Mike Lindell. He targets our institutions and undermines democracy while the Jan. 6 rioters who attacked our nation’s Capitol are pardoned and walk free.
**This is not the constitutional republic that our Founding Fathers conceived – but rather, the very autocratic tyranny they sought to prevent. For two and a half centuries, our great experiment of democracy has persisted, and we must _not_ allow the tyrant that is Donald Trump to undo it all.**
I remain fully on the side of democracy. I will use every power I have in the Senate to protect the American people and our cherished democratic institutions from Trump's corruption and would-be authoritarianism. But this is a fight for all of us. We must _all_ remain vigilant and continue to call out Trump's behavior as we see it: pure and unabashed tyranny that must be stopped.

Sincerely,

Dick

Peter, It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 __and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. **Now, I'm grateful to again serve as an Honorary Grand Marshal on the 20th anniversary of this important event.** This year will be a remembrance like no other, as we commemorate the 80th anniversary of victory in World War II and the 250th birthdays of the U.S. Army, Navy, and Marine Corps. **[Peter, the National Memorial Day Parade is ENTIRELY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous Americans like you. Will you help chip in today to help support the Parade with a gift of $25, $50, $75, $150, or more?](https://links.iterable.com/s/c/Dw2DqPlWGWN_6aHx2Wc2FUr9fnWLDJM0jUqpYZjaJkj_8lRk2u_WawTaKSRaOjtiWypxH_CvpJ_VomemxrMHETD3vwmCoR8Thg4mU0vHoVACZX0ZwYwvNU41iXO-l6LnMKKTpN1IcJUunMwCmaGaapmYtBr6fzJATwGxgKmtJiSZzzin6V11aSGdx_wV8WmjS0zA7TusDRa44oJn4HOSMd1ZeDMiQOIODQMDbEC_KBWD349mnzEPUnSqYYf2xwOpD17owyOVh7XSf5rar0EyYQbo-3oBNjjF-yXzzV17SdxA-G-Imv2_xlaMP5jlhXi7IJioBhNp7_wZ2kL2ghyQ4grWhGxC1XQDntTugtN1mhlsRrEqFw3YB9ZZd19B0vClMmeZTtFGDymF-5fOQN_Rx06BapebwNnefBqLpz_FLz2BGokpRStPcJXWnTnSuP5zgWx74SDYsLRtKJw1xqTg_SOJxtk/N2fhlbWLfAD61OHUNMVOC1XrMfQ9Jur-/8)**

The National Memorial Day Parade costs a fraction of other major public events to put on each year. In fact, _the entire parade_ costs about as much as just THREE balloons in the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade or TWO floats in the Rose Bowl Parade! _That means that every dollar that 's contributed by a generous American like you makes a difference for this important event._ **But I want to reiterate that American Veterans Center does not take ANY federal funding for this event. It is funded _entirely_ by private citizens like you who want to honor those who have sacrificed so much for our country.** Your support of the American Veterans Center not only helps the Parade, but also supports great programs like:
* Record hundreds of oral histories of veterans from World War II to Today before we lose these stories forever.

* Hold our National Youth Summit which allows young students a chance to hear first-hand from veterans from WWII, Korea, and Vietnam.

* Produce veteran focused T.V. documentaries and specials that remind Americans the price of our freedom.

[](https://links.iterable.com/s/c/xA02kspAp22rKraMXSepyn4cvPjtroXVS8HTGoc6WyjIrO4dAFVd1yZ7YYHZgvaFl3N4alzBcS5MAHrmvC5dQYfLE_CFY-Bnkzqvo29GewkIEcCMVBc8zFOhzXXr7axjjbFcykevNeawDVSMm7r_iZ65oEOP9DVLxt1RigIwwlKw3ifdD6Cj21B8jQuSQUfFv7fTcbSXSyZmXGQYgtta3DyUtU01C9XdzE13lBCXpS6NGaETAePmMBxZHVW_eSJIxeCLxEmY4kNHn189nO91BasTkds0MlxtRNUkmFslYvz4V-Ouq0bwYon5BtYbQ6p29x3aSHGaEDdcl6AFu0YcprOT_Z5IDj0nFrWxAVc4ZBYNTUyHIAvbRkfdQg6CrTOhqClN9fQzU54gZoTUp5AdLsbUNNC3zzY9cocoN2T0PNd3bBD9V46JkWz8c-ezZYI4qHarCT0/1eGVIcgfrdJOzWhGHsrBQOLs725UAbBA/8)[**Please join me in support of the National Memorial Day Parade with a gift of $25, $50, $75, $150, $250, $500, or more right now.**](https://links.iterable.com/s/c/prh5GXIsgGxxUJq90V5Hqc1QXf5QrP6ejLgrUdBD28K0mFDj6_xtBGekvVTSog71pAFfwQFtR7i6oueKc6zazFmax9PIS-RdCXBbLODhY4wnGCLmpG0BlNSwiLTrCStBs9IdRvEPhbP_yh34mFpjEzRx0HiRtHEI_YaG4wqaZpRP8-xpcODsWs3kK5-6GnHN5l_L9Fd5n7IJAsxMir1vdc6tkAo238qn5oHkUb4nlf7uhU5sRb-4mGPIQSjEvZ45CSTcjFw0_-dyLmjuTlqvqaY4oXs16zPpojwDVpCuQp_xzxA4ZvNpfvZUjHnWgdUkSekHzYULepv27T5ymljGILINSPI50Fy8MS5KYuGgYYM7MIuX0uCaTWD4vIVndsK7qrF1SkxnayvK7WVr4NmUKbJ99EN6aPy4qcJbOiYwJChfRoOu9XwFjNkrQZBH4xk-Ea6K8ScmaupN0OaacLQjFR2HQd4/i_u8zWN4ui-zkrxLu8ShXvlC6to6ae9v/8) If you've been looking for an opportunity to give back to those who have given so much for our freedom, this is one of the best possible ways you could do it. _And for a special group of veterans, this might be one of the last chances we get._ You see, with each year that goes by, we lose more and more of our World War II veterans, and for the few we have remaining, traveling to Washington, D.C., for the parade is difficult. WWII veterans were a key part of the first parade when it was revived in 2005, as they have been every year since for the last 20 years. _But this may be the last year we have the opportunity to have these brave men and women with us for the parade._** ** **That's why we are making a concerted effort to ensure these veterans are at this year's National Memorial Day Parade to honor them one last time. ** So this year, as we mark the 80th anniversary of victory in Europe and Japan to end World War II - and the 250th anniversaries of the Army, Navy, and Marine Corps - I encourage you to help us honor these brave veterans while we still have them with us.

And no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you. On Memorial Day - not just this momentous year of military milestones, but every year - please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. Visit a local veterans' cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. I'm grateful to again serve as an Honorary Grand Marshal on the 20th anniversary of this important event. | | | Peter, It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. Now, I'm grateful to again serve as an Honorary Grand Marshal on the 20th anniversary of this important event. This year will be a remembrance like no other, as we commemorate the 80th anniversary of victory in World War II and the 250th birthdays of the U.S. Army, Navy, and Marine Corps. The National Memorial Day Parade costs a fraction of other major public events to put on each year. In fact, the entire parade costs about as much as just THREE balloons in the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade or TWO floats in the Rose Bowl Parade! That means that every dollar that 's contributed by a generous American like you makes a difference for this important event. But I want to reiterate that American Veterans Center does not take ANY federal funding for this event. It is funded entirely by private citizens like you who want to honor those who have sacrificed so much for our country. Your support of the American Veterans Center not only helps the Parade, but also supports great programs like: Record hundreds of oral histories of veterans from World War II to Today before we lose these stories forever. Hold our National Youth Summit which allows young students a chance to hear first-hand from veterans from WWII, Korea, and Vietnam. Produce veteran focused T.V. documentaries and specials that remind Americans the price of our freedom. If you've been looking for an opportunity to give back to those who have given so much for our freedom, this is one of the best possible ways you could do it. And for a special group of veterans, this might be one of the last chances we get. You see, with each year that goes by, we lose more and more of our World War II veterans, and for the few we have remaining, traveling to Washington, D.C., for the parade is difficult. WWII veterans were a key part of the first parade when it was revived in 2005, as they have been every year since for the last 20 years. But this may be the last year we have the opportunity to have these brave men and women with us for the parade. That's why we are making a concerted effort to ensure these veterans are at this year's National Memorial Day Parade to honor them one last time. So this year, as we mark the 80th anniversary of victory in Europe and Japan to end World War II - and the 250th anniversaries of the Army, Navy, and Marine Corps - I encourage you to help us honor these brave veterans while we still have them with us. And no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you. On Memorial Day - not just this momentous year of military milestones, but every year - please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. Visit a local veterans' cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. I believe that while we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, we can always do a little more. ** Sincerely, Gary SiniseHonorary Grand MarshalNational Memorial Day Parade The mission of the American Veterans Center and the World War II Veterans Committee is to preserve and promote the legacy and experiences of America's veterans and active duty service personnel from World War II through today. ---
| | | **PA Dems, With the Support of the DNC, Files Opposition Brief in US Supreme Court to Protect the Rights of Pennsylvania Voters**
---
| | | _Republicans are trying to supersede the jurisdiction of the PA Supreme Court, end PA voters’ right to cast provisional ballots on Election Day_
Today, the Pennsylvania Democratic Party, with the support of the DNC, filed an opposition brief in the US Supreme Court to protect the rights of PA voters to have their vote counted.

The RNC and Pennsylvania Republicans attempted to end long-standing law in Pennsylvania that allows Pennsylvania voters who voted early by mail but have errors on their mail-in ballot to cast a provisional ballot in-person on Election Day to ensure their vote is counted. The Pennsylvania Supreme Court ruled against Republicans in October and now, Republicans are trying to supersede the long-standing sovereignty of the Pennsylvania Supreme Court and bring this case to the US Supreme Court.

**Democrats are fighting back, filing an opposition brief in this case, for two reasons:**

1\. Pennsylvania voters deserve to have their votes counted if a simple error on their mail-in ballot occurs.

2\. The Pennsylvania Supreme Court has ultimate jurisdiction in this case and change in that precedent would invalidate State Supreme Court sovereignty over voting rights cases across the country.

With important judicial retention races coming up in November, the DNC is fighting for the rights of every Pennsylvania voter.

_**DNC Chair Ken Martin issued the following statement:**_
“Pennsylvanians deserve to have their votes counted in every election – full stop. Simple errors on mail-in ballots shouldn’t impede Pennsylvanians from exercising their rights at the ballot box. The Pennsylvania Supreme Court agrees, which is why they ruled that all Pennsylvanians who submitted disqualified mail ballots must have the right to cast, and have counted, provisional ballots on Election Day. Now, the Republican Party is trying to upend state sovereignty and end this practice, all based on obscure and debunked legal theories. The DNC is standing up for Pennsylvania voters because the stakes are too high not to fight back.”
_**Pennsylvania Democratic Party Chair Sharif Street issued the following statement:**_
“Pennsylvania is the birthplace of American freedom and democracy and the DNC is fighting to ensure that Pennsylvania voters have their votes counted. Pennsylvania Republicans are trying to game the vote in their favor and that’s why they’re trying to upend Pennsylvania’s sovereignty and end long-standing voting practice in the state. With important Pennsylvania elections in November and in 2026, the DNC isn’t taking anything to chance when it comes to winning back the state. Pennsylvania will continue our fight with every resource we have – because the stakes are too high.”
**To read the full Democratic opposition brief in the US Supreme Court,**[**click here**](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=8294f3fa0c&e=d6c5c7d7ec)**.**

[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/bc34d2f8-2308-4d86-b753-1364ca4ff4a3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

"Does it mean the talks are not going in the direction the Secretary wants or you don't think a big breakthrough will happen?"
Bruce informed the CNN host that the Rubio and the Trump administration, was wholly committed to reaching a peace deal.
"If a trip is postponed or called off, it does not speak at all to the nature of the commitment of already what's been accomplished and what continues to be worked on," Bruce said.
Brown pressed on, insinuating that the U.S. peace deal attempts were unfair to Ukraine and that the U.S. was "letting Russia get away with it (the invasion)."
But Bruce did not stand for it for one second, "Let's make something quite clear here, this is not going to be discussed on T.V., not between you or me,... I do respect President Zelensky and he's going to say what he needs to say, but there is a reason why we do want to be able to sit down and talk and the Secretary has been committed to that!"
"I've answered you multiple times!" Bruce snapped.

# Does your neck hurt from all that whiplash?
On April 9th, markets threw a massive party - one of the biggest rallies since WWII.
Why? Trump paused some of the scariest tariff hikes for most countries. But on April 10th, markets plunged. Dow down nearly 1,000 points. Nasdaq tumbling.
Why? The China trade fight didn't pause - it escalated. _Badly**.**_
Tariffs on Chinese goods reportedly jumped to over 100%. China fired back with 84% tariffs on U.S. goods. The U.S. doubled down - raising tariffs to 125%.
JP Morgan called it "merely the end of the beginning." The problem hasn't vanished. What does that mean? The potential cost explosion is still very real for phones, clothes, gadgets... and especially batteries.
Like lithium batteries powering almost everything - still mostly processed in China. Imagine 125% tariffs on those. What happens to EV battery prices? Home backup systems?
This kind of shockwave forces a hard truth: Relying on fragile global supply chains is a losing game. America must build critical tech here. Especially batteries. Securely. Affordably.
This is exactly why **[Next Thing Technologies](https://substack.com/redirect/16f5e90a-8b56-44dd-8557-fff72cb38d3b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/16f5e90a-8b56-44dd-8557-fff72cb38d3b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)exists. We've focused on non-lithium batteries since 2019. Our chemistry of choice after 4+ years of research? _Sodium_ \- abundant in the U.S., Enough to last hundreds of thousands of years.
So, when tariffs make lithium batteries impossibly expensive, our domestic solution becomes the obvious choice.
Affordable. Secure. American-made.
We built our strategy for this exact moment. For a world where domestic energy isn't a luxury - but essential.
This isn't "lucky." It's strategy meeting perfect timing. That said, "lucky" for you...

# **Tom Homan DESTROYS entire mob of reporters, HUMILIATES them for crying about "due process"**
Trump Border Czar Tom Homan **[fired back at reporters](https://substack.com/redirect/fa5dc633-cbb3-4af2-b03a-06983179b372?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** about the deportation of alleged MS-13 gang member and illegal immigrant Kilmar Abrego Garcia.
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/3e74f514-deef-4ce7-b479-5596cda3c933?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/3e74f514-deef-4ce7-b479-5596cda3c933?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Garcia, recently deported back to El Salvador, has garnered the attention and sympathy of liberal media outlets and protesters, demanding that his removal by the Trump administration did not follow "due process."
In a live press conference, Homan **[demolished these liberal journalists](https://substack.com/redirect/3e74f514-deef-4ce7-b479-5596cda3c933?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**. "I find it incredible there's all this push for more, more, more due process - more process for these designated terrorists when in fact, **[no one asked for due process when they crossed the border.](https://substack.com/redirect/3e74f514-deef-4ce7-b479-5596cda3c933?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** "
One reporter asked Homan how he felt about the Department of Justice's suggestion to facilitate Garcia's return.
"I'll leave that to the Department of Justice and the State Department," Homan said. "I stand by we did the right thing for the safety and security of this country. **[We removed a terrorist.](https://substack.com/redirect/3e74f514-deef-4ce7-b479-5596cda3c933?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** "
The Border Czar then went on to lay out sharp tongued statistics about the sky-rocketed levels of sex trafficking, fentanyl overdoses, and illegal border crossings, calling out the liberal media's intentional blind eye.
**[Hear Homan's blazing remarks about crime rates and his life-saving border patrol below:](https://substack.com/redirect/3e74f514-deef-4ce7-b479-5596cda3c933?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

| Peter,

The mainstream media has launched an all-out disgusting smear campaign against President Trump’s Secretary of Defense, Pete Hegseth.

_They’re trying to force his resignation with biased and false reporting based on nothing more than rumors and downright LIES!_

name: Ellen R. Malcolm, EMILYs List
subject: Reasons for hope:
body:
|

[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/106495504/541694305/-1686146655?refcode=WUEFE458_20250425_ERMRS_ALL&sourceid=1055994&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmM2JjZjg5ZS1lNjIxLWYwMTEtOGIzZC02MDQ1YmRlZDhjY2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=i0HoCW_3jQloQnpMGlMBODebZsfnQyj4eJmp2yPtEcU=) Peter,

As we endure the daily barrage of chaos and corruption from the second Trump White House, here's a reminder:

The rage, fear, and sadness we feel is only part of the story. Finding opportunity in defeat is what has kept me doing this work for 40 years and counting.

Here's what I know for sure: We're not going to sit by while Trump tries to destroy our democracy. We will capitalize on our anger, we will fight back, and we will win.

**I want to tell you a story from the early days of EMILYs List that I've been thinking about a lot lately. It's about defeat, hope, and what comes next:**

In 1992, in the wake of Anita Hill's bravery during Clarence Thomas' Supreme Court hearings, women nationwide rose up and turned out in _historic numbers_ to elect Democratic women _. _EMILYs List's membership grew from 3,000 to 24,000 that year. We raised $6.5 million for our candidates. **And we elected four Democratic women to the U.S. Senate and 20 to the U.S. House.** It was an extraordinary, record-shattering year. After all that success, we thought we could accomplish _anything_.

And then came 1994.

Newt Gingrich rolled out the GOP's "Contract with America" legislative platform, seeking to nationalize the midterm elections. And it worked. Republicans picked up 54 U.S. House seats and 10 U.S. Senate seats, taking control of both chambers. We lost some of the women we had just worked _so hard_ to elect in 1992.

It was dubbed the "Republican Revolution." And in the aftermath, all the media wanted to talk about was how voters were sick of Democrats, how we had alienated the white men in our base, and how the American people no longer believed Democrats could deliver for them. It was a real moment of reckoning for our party. (Sound familiar?)

So here's what we did: We doubled down. We launched our "Boot Newt" campaign to combat the new speaker's extremist agenda, and we fought voter apathy by going straight to the press to let Americans know exactly what we stood for. We created the EMILYs List major donor program, which has gone on to raise hundreds of millions of dollars. We built a powerful political program that directly assists our women in launching and running their campaigns. And we launched Women Vote, our massively successful independent expenditure arm, which has helped elect hundreds of Democratic pro-choice women over the past 30 years.

**1992 is the year that put EMILYs List on the map. But if it weren't for the losses of 1994, EMILYs List may not have become the powerhouse institution it is today.**

The business of making real social change through electoral politics isn't easy, and it isn't linear. I call it "leaping and creeping" — we make big leaps forward, and then we face some tough losses, and then we creep forward again, win by win. As we celebrate 40 years of EMILYs List, I'm here to tell you, Peter: _We're always moving forward_. Even when it feels like all is lost. _Over time, we are making real and lasting change_. That's the story of EMILYs List, it's the story of the Democratic Party, and it's the story of America.

There's no way around it: The Trump administration poses an existential threat to our rights and our democracy. And while there are many reasons for fear, outrage, and disappointment, there are just as many reasons for hope. Together, we will rebuild and recover. The next leap is around the corner.

Thank you for being with EMILYs List, today and always.

Ellen Malcolm
Founder, EMILYs List

clean_body: | = Peter, As we endure the daily barrage of chaos and corruption from the second Trump White House, here's a reminder: The rage, fear, and sadness we feel is only part of the story. Finding opportunity in defeat is what has kept me doing this work for 40 years and counting. Here's what I know for sure: We're not going to sit by while Trump tries to destroy our democracy. We will capitalize on our anger, we will fight back, and we will win. I want to tell you a story from the early days of EMILYs List that I've been thinking about a lot lately. It's about defeat, hope, and what comes next: In 1992, in the wake of Anita Hill's bravery during Clarence Thomas' Supreme Court hearings, women nationwide rose up and turned out in historic numbers to elect Democratic women . EMILYs List's membership grew from 3,000 to 24,000 that year. We raised $6.5 million for our candidates. And we elected four Democratic women to the U.S. Senate and 20 to the U.S. House. It was an extraordinary, record-shattering year. After all that success, we thought we could accomplish anything. And then came 1994. Newt Gingrich rolled out the GOP's "Contract with America" legislative platform, seeking to nationalize the midterm elections. And it worked. Republicans picked up 54 U.S. House seats and 10 U.S. Senate seats, taking control of both chambers. We lost some of the women we had just worked so hard to elect in 1992. It was dubbed the "Republican Revolution." And in the aftermath, all the media wanted to talk about was how voters were sick of Democrats, how we had alienated the white men in our base, and how the American people no longer believed Democrats could deliver for them. It was a real moment of reckoning for our party. (Sound familiar?) So here's what we did: We doubled down. We launched our "Boot Newt" campaign to combat the new speaker's extremist agenda, and we fought voter apathy by going straight to the press to let Americans know exactly what we stood for. We created the EMILYs List major donor program, which has gone on to raise hundreds of millions of dollars. We built a powerful political program that directly assists our women in launching and running their campaigns. And we launched Women Vote, our massively successful independent expenditure arm, which has helped elect hundreds of Democratic pro-choice women over the past 30 years. 1992 is the year that put EMILYs List on the map. But if it weren't for the losses of 1994, EMILYs List may not have become the powerhouse institution it is today. The business of making real social change through electoral politics isn't easy, and it isn't linear. I call it "leaping and creeping" — we make big leaps forward, and then we face some tough losses, and then we creep forward again, win by win. As we celebrate 40 years of EMILYs List, I'm here to tell you, Peter: We're always moving forward. Even when it feels like all is lost. Over time, we are making real and lasting change. That's the story of EMILYs List, it's the story of the Democratic Party, and it's the story of America. There's no way around it: The Trump administration poses an existential threat to our rights and our democracy. And while there are many reasons for fear, outrage, and disappointment, there are just as many reasons for hope. Together, we will rebuild and recover. The next leap is around the corner. Thank you for being with EMILYs List, today and always. Ellen Malcolm Founder, EMILYs List = | = = = | | | | ---|---|---|---|--- Thank you for being a supporter of EMILYs List. body:
The President is trying to silence the American people and his political opponents with his latest executive order.
# [](https://act.robbonta.com/go/3?refcode=em20250425&t=1&akid=1754%2E1088799%2EKdDVb3)
Breaking news: **President Trump just issued a presidential memorandum attacking the main grassroots fundraising platform** that fuels Democratic campaigns across the country like ours.
This is an unprecedented move to silence the American people who contribute to candidates and causes they believe in, and to silence the President’s opponents.
It comes after the Trump administration launched similar attacks on colleges and universities as well as law firms that were involved in legal cases against Trump, his first administration, and his allies.
Frankly, it’s in line with what dictators in other countries do. **This political retribution is a dangerous sign of authoritarianism and cannot be taken lightly.**
Trump and his administration have made it clear through their nonstop barrage of unconstitutional executive actions that they aren’t just coming for some of us, but all of us.
**This is an attack on our electoral system, on political dissent, and on you.**
_Together, we can and must fight back._
I’ve already filed 14 lawsuits against this administration for other illegal actions that would harm Californians and people across the country, and I’m following this situation very closely.
**[Let’s show Trump that he won’t scare us into submission or silence.
