Trump’s tariffs are already impacting ports and trucking, and could affect store shelves. Trump’s USDA has also cancelled crucial deliveries to food banks, with Michigan food banks losing $4.3 million worth of emergency food—about 2 million meals. Our communities will be more in need with domino effects to come as people have to start paying student loans again and we face cuts to food banks, school meals, and so many social safety net programs. Part of how we collectively resist is by helping our neighbors and preparing our communities for what’s to come. Here are some things you can do as an individual to defend our communities from right-wing attacks: Volunteer at and donate to local food banks. (You can find many by entering your zip code on ) Go to a demonstration or a training near you. “Work your backyard”: Connect with your neighbors and loved ones , and invite them to attend a protest, training, or meeting. Join and support community-based organizations or local mutual aid groups. Join your local Democratic club, or your local (DSA) chapter, or your state or local Working Families Party (click “filters” at the top of to search events by location). Join national organizations taking direct action like or . Find and share resources from the or connect with your closest to learn about trainings and how to get involved in protecting protesters’ rights. Find and share resources for activism from . My team and I recently held a packed town hall, training over 300 of our district’s residents on how to advocate for our communities and for the federal programs that families need in order to thrive. We brought community organizers from groups like the Detroit and Michigan Chapter of the National Lawyers Guild: And Michigan United Action: We heard back from town hall attendees that it gave them hope to learn about what local groups are doing and about how people-led grassroots movements have successfully mobilized to move the government and powerful institutions. The fascists want us to be afraid and isolated. But we have power, especially when we come together. Last week, Leaders We Deserve announced a $20 million effort to primary out-of-touch, ineffective incumbent House Democrats to replace them with generational young leaders. **[If you can, I’m asking you to chip in $5 to power this urgent work.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20250425-1?refcode=em20250425-2039&amount=5&refcode2=2039_587540_w5Ei2Z&akid=2039%2E587540%2Ew5Ei2Z)**
I want to be transparent about why we made this announcement when we did – and why your support today will determine whether or not we can put young people on the ballot in 2026.
Right now, there are too many politicians occupying safe blue seats who aren’t putting up enough of a fight against Donald Trump. They’re failing to meet the moment, and it’s leaving more and more voters disillusioned about what Democrats even stand for.
**But as you read this, there are young, inspiring, and brave leaders out there who are in the process of deciding whether to run for office.** If we can demonstrate that there’s a loud, powerful, and well-funded movement who’s ready to support their campaigns with everything we’ve got, then maybe – _just maybe_ – they’ll decide to get into the arena and lead our party into the future. But if they decide their campaigns are over before they even begin, there won’t be any Gen Z leaders for us to vote for come Election Day in 2026.
**That’s why our work needs to happen now, Peter.** Next spring or next fall will be too little, too late. It’s why Leaders We Deserve just made our big announcement about supporting young progressives who decide to challenge asleep-at-the-wheel House Democrats in safe seats. And it’s why we’re counting on you to commit to this work today:
**[Will you donate $5 to elect the next generation of young leaders who will rebuild our party? What we do right now will determine whether Democrats are in a position to win back the House in 2026.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20250425-1?refcode=em20250425-2039&amount=5&refcode2=2039_587540_w5Ei2Z&akid=2039%2E587540%2Ew5Ei2Z)**

Thanks for being a part of this,
David Hogg
Leaders We Deserve

As the Finance Director, it is my responsibility to ensure we hit our financial goals so that our campaign has the resources it needs to compete in this race.
In fact, our first big test is in less than a week— our April end-of-month fundraising deadline.

Michael knows that the solutions, leadership, and hope our country desperately needs will come from right here in Colorado.
By working together, Michael will help solve the biggest challenges facing our state and take on the abhorrent and unpopular policies of the Trump administration.
But I’m reviewing our numbers, and I’m worried we’re going to fall about $6,567 short of our end-of-month goal. **My family means everything to me.** I was raised by parents who came to Colorado from Mexico in search of a better life. They knew that hard work and caring for others are the values that build strong communities and families. They raised me and my siblings with those values – on a construction worker’s salary in Adams County.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/106515205/541757488/-1483475117?refcode=email_042525_mystory&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjUwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNzFmYTEwYi0wODIyLWYwMTEtOGIzZC02MDQ1YmRlZDhjY2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wsD0lsvzI2i4Dx6xKrOQbUTGpQBNsNo9HS59fe_iNPg=)
**I became the first in my family to graduate from college and became a pediatrician** – a testament to the American Dream. I chose to work in Adams County to give back to the community that raised me, but I quickly realized that families were struggling with rising healthcare and drug costs.
**[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/106515207/541757492/-1483475117?refcode=email_042525_mystory&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjUwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNzFmYTEwYi0wODIyLWYwMTEtOGIzZC02MDQ1YmRlZDhjY2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wsD0lsvzI2i4Dx6xKrOQbUTGpQBNsNo9HS59fe_iNPg=)**
**That’s why I ran for the state legislature.** There, I took on Big Pharma, helped pass a first-in-the-nation cap on the price of insulin, and worked to lower the cost of prescription drugs. But I knew I could do more.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/106515209/541757494/-1483475117?refcode=email_042525_mystory&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjUwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNzFmYTEwYi0wODIyLWYwMTEtOGIzZC02MDQ1YmRlZDhjY2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wsD0lsvzI2i4Dx6xKrOQbUTGpQBNsNo9HS59fe_iNPg=)
**So, I ran for Congress in 2022.** Thanks to this grassroots movement, I defied the odds and won – becoming the first Latina to represent Colorado in Congress. I worked every day to build on my work to lower healthcare costs, address the high cost of living, and defend working families.
But in 2024, I came up just short against Gabe Evans, losing Colorado’s 8th District by _just 2,449 votes_.
Now, Gabe Evans has gone all-in on Trump and his extreme agenda, making life harder for working families in Colorado and threatening healthcare for millions across the state – all while giving handouts to billionaires.
[**That’s why I’m running to win back CO-08 and continue my work in Congress to protect healthcare and fight for hard working Coloradans – but I can’t do it alone. Hey Derek, it’s John.

If you’ve been following me for a while, yinz know how I feel. 👉 **The Union Way of Life is sacred.**
You don’t mess with it. You always gotta fight for it.
Whether it’s nurses walking the picket line or federal workers fighting Trump’s attacks in court, union folks know I have their back. ✊
But right now, a bunch of billionaire clowns and rich politicians are trying to take workers’ rights, cut benefits, and bust up unions. 😡 Nah, dude. Not on my watch.
So here's where you come in. **[I need to hear directly from yinz:](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/51016?code=jtk69-su-fl&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&t=2&akid=10055%2E434096%2EjdrmCo)****[What do YOU think we need to do to protect the Union Way of Life?](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/51016?code=jtk69-su-fl&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&t=3&akid=10055%2E434096%2EjdrmCo)**

name: Maxine Dexter
subject: I just got back from El Salvador

body:
https://maxinefororegon.com/ [https://maxinefororegon.com/]
Hey Peter,
I just got back from El Salvador, and I wanted to reach out.
It’s been over a month since Kilmar Abrego Garcia, a Maryland resident and father of four, was illegally deported by the Trump administration to a Salvadorian gulag.
This is an unimaginable violation of due process and human rights.
We must act. So I bought a plane ticket and flew with three of my House colleagues to demand the release of Abrego Garcia.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_med_email-25q2?refcode=X_250425_ElSalvadorRecap_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_med_email-25q2?refcode=X_250425_ElSalvadorRecap_act]
Watch my interview on ABC News [https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/video/us-lawmakers-denied-meeting-kilmar-abgrego-garcia-121050225]
When we arrived, we weren’t allowed to see him or receive any assurances of his well-being. Prison and government authorities wouldn’t even tell us if he was still alive.
This happened despite a federal judge and the Supreme Court ordering the Trump administration to facilitate Abrego Garcia’s return to the United States. This is a constitutional crisis, a presidential overreach, a state-sanctioned but unlawful kidnapping of a Maryland resident. If Donald Trump can defy the courts for one family, he can do it to us, too.
Instead of innocent until proven guilty, the Trump administration decided Abrego Garcia doesn’t deserve legal rights because of his race and where he was born.
Abrego Garcia is still imprisoned—but we won’t stop fighting.
We’ll continue filing suits for Abrego Garcia and the other people who have been kidnapped by the Trump administration. We’ll press the Salvadorian government to provide proof that these men are alive and healthy. And we’ll force the Trump administration to back down by showing that the American people are on our side.
This is bigger than one man. This is setting a precedent for protecting our democracy.
That’s why we need more people-powered, grassroots defiance to hold this administration accountable and boot out Trump’s enablers. Will you donate what you can today? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_med_email-25q2?refcode=X_250425_ElSalvadorRecap_act]

[] Watch my interview on ABC News [] When we arrived, we weren’t allowed to see him or receive any assurances of his well-being. Prison and government authorities wouldn’t even tell us if he was still alive. This happened despite a federal judge and the Supreme Court ordering the Trump administration to facilitate Abrego Garcia’s return to the United States. This is a constitutional crisis, a presidential overreach, a state-sanctioned but unlawful kidnapping of a Maryland resident. If Donald Trump can defy the courts for one family, he can do it to us, too. Instead of innocent until proven guilty, the Trump administration decided Abrego Garcia doesn’t deserve legal rights because of his race and where he was born. Abrego Garcia is still imprisoned—but we won’t stop fighting. We’ll continue filing suits for Abrego Garcia and the other people who have been kidnapped by the Trump administration. We’ll press the Salvadorian government to provide proof that these men are alive and healthy. And we’ll force the Trump administration to back down by showing that the American people are on our side. This is bigger than one man. This is setting a precedent for protecting our democracy. That’s why we need more people-powered, grassroots defiance to hold this administration accountable and boot out Trump’s enablers. Dear Patriot,

Welcome to Pennsylvania Moms for America (PMFA)! We're thrilled to have you join a community of passionate, empowered mothers who
are determined to make a lasting impact on the future of our families and our state.

At PMFA, we believe that mothers are the heart of our communities, and we are working every day to ensure our voices are heard on
the issues that matter most to us: family values, parental rights, education, and more.

Why Should You Join?

By joining PMFA, you become a part of a growing movement of mothers who are making real change. Here’s why you should be
involved:

* Make a Real Impact: We advocate for policies that support families and protect our children’s futures. Whether it’s school
choice, healthcare, or safe communities, your voice can help us create positive change.

* Connect with Like-Minded Moms: Meet moms from all over Pennsylvania who share your passion for family-centered values.
Together, we can strengthen our community and make our voices heard.

* Empowerment & Education: We provide educational resources to help you become an effective advocate for your children and
family. Learn how to engage in local activism, stay informed on critical issues, and take meaningful action.

[] [] Dear Patriot, Welcome to Pennsylvania Moms for America (PMFA)! We're thrilled to have you join a community of passionate, empowered mothers who are determined to make a lasting impact on the future of our families and our state. At PMFA, we believe that mothers are the heart of our communities, and we are working every day to ensure our voices are heard on the issues that matter most to us: family values, parental rights, education, and more. Why Should You Join? By joining PMFA, you become a part of a growing movement of mothers who are making real change. Here’s why you should be involved: Make a Real Impact: We advocate for policies that support families and protect our children’s futures. Whether it’s school choice, healthcare, or safe communities, your voice can help us create positive change. Connect with Like-Minded Moms: Meet moms from all over Pennsylvania who share your passion for family-centered values. Together, we can strengthen our community and make our voices heard. Empowerment & Education: We provide educational resources to help you become an effective advocate for your children and family. Learn how to engage in local activism, stay informed on critical issues, and take meaningful action. Your Family, Your Voice: At PMFA, your perspective matters. Together, we’ll work to ensure that every mom has the tools and resources to create the best possible future for her children. Ready to Take Action? It’s time to turn your passion into action! Here’s how you can get started today: Join Us Now: Click here [] to become a member of Pennsylvania Moms for America. When you join, you’ll receive updates on upcoming events, opportunities to volunteer, and ways to get involved with local initiatives. Stay Informed: Check out our Resource Center [] for valuable tools, articles, and guides on how to become a stronger advocate for your family. * Connect with Us: Join our private Facebook Group [] to interact with other local moms, share your experiences, and stay up-to-date with everything happening in our movement. Together, we can make sure that Pennsylvania’s families are heard and valued. Thank you for taking the first step toward making a real difference. We’re excited to have you with us! clean_body: | Welcome to the Indiana Democratic Party's weekly newsletter, The Kernel of Truth. The State Party will provide the most important fact - a kernel of truth - from the week. = ** Tallian: Braun, GOP Leave Hoosiers Up Creek Without a Paddle On early Friday morning, the Indiana General Assembly adjourned Sine Die, bringing an end to the 2025 legislative session. Governor Mike Braun and the GOP supermajority’s achievements include: , a benefit wealthy landowners (), paid for by higher income taxes on working class Hoosiers. , which once again reduces K-12 education funding as a share of the budget, cuts funding for all public universities, and even reduces public health funding by a whopping 72% year over year. , which will inject partisan politics into Hoosier children’s education by forcing candidates for school board to declare party affiliation. The and Braun’s to appoint all of the members of the Indiana University Board of Trustees, eliminating alumni input. In contrast to these out-of-touch policies, the Indiana House and Senate Democratic Caucuses proposed: The Working Hoosiers Agenda to reduce healthcare costs, end junk fees, and put more money back in the pockets of Hoosier families – all while fully funding the public schools 90% of Hoosier kids attend. A plan to regulate and legalize cannabis use in Indiana to keep our tax dollars in state for our schools, police, fire, and emergency services. All of these proposals were defeated by the Republican majority. Despite this, some Democratic legislators were able to pass legislation which: Prevents any future luxury vehicle purchase by state officials, requiring them to purchase only standard model vehicles on taxpayer money. (). It was directly in response to the state spending nearly on luxury vehicles for Micah Beckwith and Diego Morales. Allows parents the ability to take time off work for their child’s attendance conference or case conference committee meeting without the possibility of losing their job or facing retaliation. ( This session makes it clear, once again, that the Indiana Republican Party is completely out of step with Hoosiers and Democrats are the ones fighting for Hoosiers. Indiana Democratic Party Chair Karen Tallian released the following statement in response: “Indiana Republicans have enough votes in the legislature to do anything they want, but their knee-jerk reaction is always: ‘let’s cut taxes’; unfortunately for Hoosiers, this tax-cut is merely a shell game. They crow about their tax cut, but are truly just forcing local governments to raise income taxes on working Hoosiers,” saidTallian. “At the same time, their property tax overhaul is a massive handout to wealthy landowners, like Mike Braun himself, paid for by a local income tax hike on working class Hoosiers. “Given the rest of the economic bad news trickling down into Indiana from the federal administration, the Governor should at least have put a 2-year hold on this property tax debacle. “At the same time, the GOP put together a budget that was not kind from the beginning. Then, after the poor economic forecast, additional funding for public health was cut by millions in order for them to save their unreasonable voucher program. Meanwhile, our Lieutenant Governor and Secretary of State go hot-rodding around in luxury vehicles paid for by the taxpayers. Any Hoosier should find this incomprehensible. “Simply put, the Indiana Republican Party has once again left Hoosiers up the creek without a paddle, while Democrats have continued to fight for the issues that matter most to our citizens.” Sneaky Last Minute Provisions Added to State Budget The Republican supermajority at the Statehouse used the cover of chaotic final days of session to sneak in language on a number of issues, without the ability for Hoosiers to testify on these issues. This includes a last-minute power grab by Governor Braun on Indiana University. The changes allow him to solely appoint the Board of Trustees members at IU. Currently, alumni elect three of nine members, but with this change, they will have no input. The Republican supermajority knows its agenda is unpopular with Hoosiers, and is using the cover of darkness to try and hide their destructive agenda. Each week, the State Party will highlight key policy from Democrats at the Statehouse or across the state. Democrats deliver a better future for Hoosier families, and we urge you to share this information with your networks. This week’s legislative shoutout goes to freshman State Senator Mark Spencer (Gary) for passing a bill to improve public safety in his very first legislative session. His bill, Senate Bill 331, requires vehicle records to be updated with the BMV when its color changes due to car wraps or paint. This gives our law enforcement officers another tool to stop criminals and those who may have stolen a vehicle and changed its color. Dear Peter, Last week, OLCV/Oregon Conservation Network (OCN) designated two more bills as Major Threats to our environment, [HB 3103-5](https://click.everyaction.com/k/106517496/541764595/319563421?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImJkYTQ4MzUzLTBmMjItZjAxMS04YjNkLTYwNDViZGVkOGNjYSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=kHJKUa1f_ecEivjqbMi78H4KIq_-pAQIOWE2t6zTV4c=&emci=9e84e01c-0522-f011-8b3d-6045bded8cca&emdi=bda48353-0f22-f011-8b3d-6045bded8cca&ceid=2107230) and [HB 2403](https://click.everyaction.com/k/106517497/541764596/-835341822?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImJkYTQ4MzUzLTBmMjItZjAxMS04YjNkLTYwNDViZGVkOGNjYSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=kHJKUa1f_ecEivjqbMi78H4KIq_-pAQIOWE2t6zTV4c=&emci=9e84e01c-0522-f011-8b3d-6045bded8cca&emdi=bda48353-0f22-f011-8b3d-6045bded8cca&ceid=2107230). In case you aren’t keeping count, that’s four Major Threats so far this session – the most we’ve faced in a while. What all of this means is that we are being forced to spend too much of our time in the Capitol defending against threats to past wins and future progress. We need your help now to ensure that we have the resources we need to secure wins for our climate and environment this session, and stop these threats. [**Will you make an urgent gift to OLCV today to help?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/106517498/541764597/-1698714710?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImJkYTQ4MzUzLTBmMjItZjAxMS04YjNkLTYwNDViZGVkOGNjYSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=kHJKUa1f_ecEivjqbMi78H4KIq_-pAQIOWE2t6zTV4c=&emci=9e84e01c-0522-f011-8b3d-6045bded8cca&emdi=bda48353-0f22-f011-8b3d-6045bded8cca&ceid=2107230)** **

Here is a snapshot of all of our Major Threats that are still active this session:
* **The Wolf Compensation Bill (**[**SB 777 -5**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/106517500/541764599/1140938071?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImJkYTQ4MzUzLTBmMjItZjAxMS04YjNkLTYwNDViZGVkOGNjYSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=kHJKUa1f_ecEivjqbMi78H4KIq_-pAQIOWE2t6zTV4c=&emci=9e84e01c-0522-f011-8b3d-6045bded8cca&emdi=bda48353-0f22-f011-8b3d-6045bded8cca&ceid=2107230)**)** would multiply up to 5x the fair market value paid for livestock killed by wolves. The multiplier, if applied, could rapidly drain half of the program’s funds and lead to less support for proven, non-lethal coexistence tools.
* **Minimum logging level for state forest land (**[**HB 3103-5)**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/106517501/541764600/319563421?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImJkYTQ4MzUzLTBmMjItZjAxMS04YjNkLTYwNDViZGVkOGNjYSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=kHJKUa1f_ecEivjqbMi78H4KIq_-pAQIOWE2t6zTV4c=&emci=9e84e01c-0522-f011-8b3d-6045bded8cca&emdi=bda48353-0f22-f011-8b3d-6045bded8cca&ceid=2107230) would set minimum logging levels established by the State Forester to be set through rulemaking and legally enforceable. Once annual levels are established for state forests, any volume not harvested in one year must be added to the following year’s harvest. This will create unrelenting pressure for the Oregon Department of Forestry (ODF) to increase harvests without an equal opportunity to adjust levels to ensure sustainable forest management.
* **Predator Control Districts** **([HB 2403](https://click.everyaction.com/k/106517502/541764601/-835341822?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImJkYTQ4MzUzLTBmMjItZjAxMS04YjNkLTYwNDViZGVkOGNjYSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=kHJKUa1f_ecEivjqbMi78H4KIq_-pAQIOWE2t6zTV4c=&emci=9e84e01c-0522-f011-8b3d-6045bded8cca&emdi=bda48353-0f22-f011-8b3d-6045bded8cca&ceid=2107230))** would allow formation of local “predator damage control districts” to fund the federal “Wildlife Services” to kill Oregon’s wildlife that are deemed a threat to private property, without having to use or consider non-lethal methods.

With your help, we have already killed one Major Threat this session – [HB 3119](https://click.everyaction.com/k/106517503/541764602/320218780?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImJkYTQ4MzUzLTBmMjItZjAxMS04YjNkLTYwNDViZGVkOGNjYSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=kHJKUa1f_ecEivjqbMi78H4KIq_-pAQIOWE2t6zTV4c=&emci=9e84e01c-0522-f011-8b3d-6045bded8cca&emdi=bda48353-0f22-f011-8b3d-6045bded8cca&ceid=2107230). Now, I’m asking for your help again to stop these current threats. clean_body: | | | Dear Peter, Last week, OLCV/Oregon Conservation Network (OCN) designated two more bills as Major Threats to our environment, and . In case you aren’t keeping count, that’s four Major Threats so far this session – the most we’ve faced in a while. What all of this means is that we are being forced to spend too much of our time in the Capitol defending against threats to past wins and future progress. We need your help now to ensure that we have the resources we need to secure wins for our climate and environment this session, and stop these threats. Here is a snapshot of all of our Major Threats that are still active this session: The Wolf Compensation Bill () would multiply up to 5x the fair market value paid for livestock killed by wolves. The multiplier, if applied, could rapidly drain half of the program’s funds and lead to less support for proven, non-lethal coexistence tools. Minimum logging level for state forest land ( would set minimum logging levels established by the State Forester to be set through rulemaking and legally enforceable. Once annual levels are established for state forests, any volume not harvested in one year must be added to the following year’s harvest. This will create unrelenting pressure for the Oregon Department of Forestry (ODF) to increase harvests without an equal opportunity to adjust levels to ensure sustainable forest management. Predator Control Districts ()** would allow formation of local “predator damage control districts” to fund the federal “Wildlife Services” to kill Oregon’s wildlife that are deemed a threat to private property, without having to use or consider non-lethal methods. With your help, we have already killed one Major Threat this session – . Now, I’m asking for your help again to stop these current threats. Keep scrolling to read about how right-wing election deniers use this tool to try to suppress the votes of people they deem undesirable. = In solidarity, The Fair Fight Team \-------------------Forwarded Message------------------- Sent: April 22, 2025 From: Fair Fight Subject: Counting on this team to help address a growing threat Team, In Georgia and across the country, far-right election deniers are using an insidious tool to try to reshape the electorate: mass voter purges. Here’s how this voter suppression tactic can work: A single right-wing activist — with guidance from a systematic anti-voter network — can submit official challenges to specific people’s voter registrations. In Georgia, Republican voter suppression legislation — passed after Trump’s 2020 loss — has allowed one person to try to purge an unlimited number of their fellow Georgians from the rolls. In those attempts, private citizens can use flawed, incomplete data — as shown by an analysis we commissioned last year — to claim that certain voters are no longer eligible. After a purge attempt, people need to jump through additional hoops to maintain their registrations. If elections officials sign off on the purge, those Americans could no longer be able to vote. And even if that doesn’t happen, the effort still forces officials to waste valuable time and serves as voter intimidation. = The threat isn’t hypothetical — just look at this headline from ProPublica investigating the consequences of new Georgia legislation that paved the way for more mass voter purges: “Close to 100,000 Voter Registrations Were Challenged in Georgia — Almost All by Just Six Right-Wing Activists” According to ProPublica, “Five of the six most prolific challengers...have assisted or been assisted by right-wing organizations, some leaders of which were involved in efforts to challenge the results of the 2020 presidential election.” Since then, Georgia GOP lawmakers pushed through a new law which has made mass voter purges even easier. This voter intimidation and suppression tool has a long history in Georgia going back to Reconstruction and carrying through to Jim Crow. We’re fighting back to protect the freedom to vote. At Fair Fight, we’ve exposed the anti-voter intentions behind mass purge attempts by spreading detailed information about how right-wing activists base their allegations on unreliable data. | | _**Celebrating a Successful Session and Stronger State**_
---
Friends, This has been an incredible week for Hoosier Republicans, as we celebrate the conclusion of the 2025 legislative session and Governor Mike Braun’s continued leadership. With the support of our Republican legislators, Governor Braun has advanced key priorities of his Freedom and Opportunity Agenda, delivering real results for Hoosiers across the state. From passing a fiscally responsible biennial budget to enacting meaningful property tax relief for homeowners, farmers, and small businesses, this session has been defined by bold, conservative action. Governor Braun and our conservative general assembly also championed universal school choice, expanded healthcare transparency, and worked towards ensuring state government remains efficient and accountable to the people it serves. In addition to legislative victories, Governor Braun continued to advance the Freedom and Opportunity Agenda through executive action, creating the Indiana Rare Earth Recovery Council—an important step in securing an American supply chain for critical materials through innovation and the use of Indiana’s own resources. Governor Braun also announced an independent forensic audit of the Indiana Economic Development Corporation (IEDC), reaffirming his administration's commitment to transparency and responsible governance. The Indiana GOP is proud to stand alongside Governor Braun and our Republican representatives as we they to make Indiana an even better place to live, work, and raise a family, and join them in celebrating a successful session. As always, thank you for being a part of our team. Please feel free to reach out if there's anything I can assist with.
---
| |
---
| | Lana Keesling, Indiana GOP Chairwoman

_**Governor Mike Braun Signs Executive Order on Rare Earth Minerals**_

**SEA 409:** Prohibits an employer from taking an adverse employment action against an employee as a result of the employee's absence from work to attend an attendance conference or a case conference committee meeting with respect to the employee's child, except under certain circumstances. Provides that an employer is not required to pay an employee for travel or attendance time with respect to a conference or meeting. Requires certain persons to provide documentation related to a conference or meeting under certain circumstances. **SEA 420****:** Establishes a procedure for the transfer of an inmate from a county jail to another county jail or the department of correction if the inmate: (1) poses a serious risk of escape; (2) demonstrates violent or aggressive behavior; or (3) needs to be protected from other inmates. **SEA 4:** Requires water utilities to obtain a certificate of public convenience and necessity (CPCN) from the Indiana Utility Regulatory Commission before constructing long haul water pipelines and outlines application requirements, conditions for approval, and cost recovery through rates. It also mandates a transfer permit from the Department of Natural Resources for significant interbasin water transfers, sets criteria for permit approval, and allows for penalties for noncompliance. **SEA 119:** Prohibits the submission of an application for a certificate of public advantage (application) after May 13, 2025. Changes the time frame in which the Indiana department of health has to review and make a determination on an application filed during a specified time frame. **SEA 143:** Provides that a governmental entity may not substantially burden certain parental rights unless the burden, as applied to the parent and the child, is required to advance a compelling governmental interest and is the least restrictive means of advancing the governmental interest. Prohibits a governmental entity from: (1) advising, directing, or coercing a child to withhold certain information from the child's parent; or (2) denying a child's parent access to certain information. Allows a parent to bring an action against a governmental entity for certain violations and provides for certain relief. Specifies that the parent of a child does not have a right to access certain medical care on behalf of the child if the child does not have an affirmative right of access to the medical care. **SEA 462:** Reenacts an expired provision in the definition of "practitioner" as it relates to behavior analysts. **SEA 491:** Allows the city of Alexandria in Madison County to annex noncontiguous property for use as an industrial park. **SEA 1126:** Alters the membership of a watershed development commission board that includes the Maumee River basin (Maumee watershed development commission). Provides that a Maumee watershed development commission may take certain actions with respect to certain flood plains. Expands permitted uses for certain funds collected by a Maumee watershed development commission and establishes certain budget limits. Provides that the department of natural resources's division of water shall provide a Maumee watershed development commission with a written summary of the division's review of certain public works projects within 30 days of the review. Makes conforming changes. **SEA 1376:** Amends the definition of "emergency medication". **SEA 1478:** Removes the sunset provision for pro bono legal services fees. **SEA 1595: **Requires the office of the secretary of family and social services to reapply before September 1, 2025, for a Medicaid state plan amendment that provides for the establishment of the long term care partnership program and the discontinuance of the current long term care program. **SEA 1633:** Requires the secretary of state to do the following: (1) Study scheduling of local elections and requiring all counties to use vote centers. (2) Conduct at least three public meetings on the topics studied. (3) Report the results of the studies to the legislative council before November 1, 2025.

name: PoliticsPA
subject: Script flipped on Housing Crisis
body:
Tune into the latest installment of the Voices of Reason podcast. | | | |
---
| | | Welcome to the latest edition of _Voices of Reason_ where we’ll recap exclusive news and data featured in our most recent podcast.

This special segment dives deep into the Democratic primary for Pittsburgh mayor and how city officials plan on addressing the housing crisis in the city.

The week features exclusive interviews with incumbent Mayor **Ed Gainey** and Allegheny County Controller **Corey O'Connor** , who share views and insights you want to know.
---
| **Big Names Make News**
---
| **Mayor Ed Gainey** highlights his past success with housing initiatives, citing the “30 million affordable housing bond” secured under his administration and outlines his plan for inclusionary zoning, which would require any new development with “20 or more units to reserve 10% for affordable housing priced at 50% of the area median income.” [[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=05b4637f0e&e=b7b3eddce2)]

**Allegheny County Controller Corey O’Connor** highlights that implementing a “blanket ordinance” of inclusionary zoning across all of Pittsburgh could do more harm than good, noting that the city currently needs “about 6,000 affordable units and 15,000 market-rate units,” and that inclusionary zoning alone is not “building enough volume of affordable housing,” especially since “every neighborhood market is different.” [[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=a59b539aa6&e=b7b3eddce2)]
---
|
* * *
---
| **Numbers You Need to Know**
---
| _Housing_
* Pittsburgh city officials have estimated that currently, there is a deficit of 10,000 affordable units in the city. [[PittsburghPost-Gazette](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=b6cea340e5&e=b7b3eddce2)]
* Lehigh Valley faces a 9,000-unit housing shortfall, with home prices already 4× the median income—projected to reach 7× by 2050 as population growth outpaces expectations by 2025. [[LehighValleyBusiness](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=7e1f1f715d&e=b7b3eddce2)]
* Allegheny County has just 36 affordable homes per 100 extremely low-income households, Wayne County faces roughly 2,000 unhoused people, and half of York’s renters struggle with housing costs. [[Fetterman.Senate.Gov](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=a7bfde5893&e=b7b3eddce2)]

_Voter Interests_
* House Bill 643, which would raise the PHARE Fund cap from $100 million to $110 million by 2028 to support affordable housing statewide, just passed the Pennsylvania House and now moves to the Senate for consideration. [[ABC27](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=a946eb071b&e=b7b3eddce2)]
* Philadelphia’s Housing Authority plans to invest $6.3 billion over 8 years to preserve or build 20,000 affordable homes as part of the Parker administration’s $2 billion H.O.M.E. plan to tackle the city’s housing crisis. [[WHYY](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=a7485c2660&e=b7b3eddce2)]
* Philadelphia’s Turn the Key program aims to build 1,000 affordable homes citywide but has completed only 240 in two years—despite approving 800 sites and having 400 more under construction. [[WHYY](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=e625dad78e&e=b7b3eddce2)]

---
|
* * *
---
| **Pittsburgh Mayoral Race & Housing Crisis**
---
| [ ](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=f6063aab7c&e=b7b3eddce2 "You Decide: Pittsburgh’s mayoral showdown begins here | Voices of Reason Election Special")
---
|
* * *
---
| **In Case You Missed It...**
---
| The _Voices of Reason_ podcast has covered the most important issues in Pennsylvania politics – from [education funding](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=6d68f53c64&e=b7b3eddce2) to [trust in elections](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=9b32865c97&e=b7b3eddce2). Secretary of the Commonwealth [Al Schmidt](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=c489ee5ba2&e=b7b3eddce2), PA Treasurer [Stacy Garrity](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=fe791f0de3&e=b7b3eddce2), and House Appropriations Chairman [Jordan Harris](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=7ddde06e06&e=b7b3eddce2) are just a few of many influential guests who have joined us for exclusive interviews and roundtable discussions.
Visit the _Voice of Reason_ [YouTube page](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=b2eddb8665&e=b7b3eddce2) to experience all the great moments you missed.

Hi Peter,
As many of you know, I’ve spent the majority of my career as an OB-GYN physician, not a politician. And as a physician, I spend most of my time listening to my patients – hearing about their challenges, what’s on their mind, what hurts, and then crafting a care plan with them. Doctors spend much more time listening than talking.
Listening to my constituents is my favorite part of this job. I have spent a lot of time in conversation with those who are facing hardships because of this administration, and a common message I hear is that Americans feel powerless in this moment. I understand that feeling, but I want you to know that using your voice works .
Just last week, 12 Republican House members sent a letter to House leadership voicing their opposition to cuts to Medicaid. With such a close margin in the House, this is huge. Peter – your voice is being heard and the pressure is working.
As a physician, I can attest first hand how devastating the proposed cuts to Medicaid would be to the 80 million Americans who rely on it. Medicaid is Minnesota’s largest source of insurance. Medicaid is the single largest payer of maternity care in this country. Medicaid pays for 62% of nursing home care. Americans don’t want to cut Medicaid, and it is time this administration puts everyday people over their billionaire friends.
Peter, I have been working to fight back against the harmful - and at times blatantly illegal - actions of this administration. The 2026 campaign is not that far away, so I am also working on raising the funds we need to keep our campaign operations running to ensure MN-03 stays blue.

name: Katie Porter
subject: Spot these common political email scams
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Governor 2026
body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21486?t=1&akid=39672%2E3422442%2EPl8Q8o)
Dear Derek,
You’ve probably seen them: political emails that try to shame or scare you into donating.
As a consumer protection attorney, I hate these scammy tactics. Let me break down some of the most common ones, so you can spot the BS (and share the knowledge with your friends and loved ones).
1. **“We need 5,238 donors from YOUR zip code.”** This is fake. Donations from different parts of the state or country can signal support, but campaigns aren’t doing crazy math like this to meet goals or deadlines.
2. **“Donate $5 today and it will be triple matched.”** There’s no mysterious fairy matching donations. Just look at how the match “offers” get higher and higher seemingly randomly the more they want you to donate.
3. **“Warning: Payment incomplete.”** These are the worst. There’s no excuse for campaigns misleading Americans into thinking they’ve missed a bill.

Here’s what is real. We have goals and timelines that we use to keep ourselves on track to raise what we need and to evaluate the volume of voter contact we can pay for.
Our April end-of-month deadline is fast approaching, and because I reject all donations from corporations, lobbyists, and executives at Big Pharma, Big Oil, and Big Banks, the only way this campaign hits its targets is by folks like you chipping in.
**[So please, Derek, I’m making a 100% BS-free ask. Will you donate $10 or whatever you can to help us hit our April goal?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_kp_20250425_1_ak?refcode=em20250425-39672&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39672_3422442_Pl8Q8o&akid=39672%2E3422442%2EPl8Q8o)**

More soon,
Katie

Late last week, the North Carolina Supreme Court issued an outrageous ruling throwing out legally cast ballots from overseas voters and specifically targeting military members from Democratic counties. This ruling requires them to once again prove their identities within a narrow 30-day window to ensure the votes they cast in November are counted. **Let me be absolutely clear: This enables a naked attempt to steal an election.** [**And we must all come together to reject these kinds of blatant attacks on our democracy.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/106519164/541770149/1925646595?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_AGNC_email_20250425-NDRC-Tier1-AGNCLiftnote_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20250425-NDRC-Tier1-AGNCLiftnote_&utm_campaign=AGNC&amount=30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjRlZTFlZjY1LTEyMjItZjAxMS04YjNkLTYwNDViZGVkOGNjYSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=yhrXaC7-aP-c1nukGuBDZGbwfjGnbqarzJtPVDkSlRw=) As a former Attorney General who made protecting voting rights a top priority at the Justice Department, I am appalled to see the judiciary abandon its most fundamental responsibility — protecting the rights of the people. Too many members of the Republican majority on North Carolina's highest court cherry-picked whose votes count based purely on partisan calculations. It is the height of political arrogance to tell military members who serve and sacrifice for our country, and other voters, that their votes and those of their family members are somehow questionable. The facts of this case aren't complicated, Peter. Multiple recounts, the state Board of Elections, and the trial court all concluded that Justice Riggs was re-elected in November. Like North Carolina Supreme Court Justice Anita Earls powerfully stated in her dissenting opinion: "It is no small thing to overturn the results of an election in a democracy by throwing out ballots that were legally cast consistent with all election laws in effect on the day of the election... Some would call it stealing the election, others might call it a bloodless coup, but by whatever name, no amount of smoke and mirrors makes it legitimate." **This case reminds us how every generation of Americans is ultimately called upon to defend democracy — to bring our nation closer to its founding ideals._Now it is our time._** It is only when the times are toughest that we are truly tested. Rest assured that we, like those before us, are up to this test. The tasks before us will not be easily accomplished. In the first year of our independence Tom Paine said, “tyranny, like hell, is not easily conquered; yet we have this consolation with us, that the harder the conflict, the more glorious the triumph. What we obtain too cheap we esteem too lightly; it is dearness only that gives everything its value.” **Together, we can defend our democracy — _and we must_.** [**As the NDRC continues to fight for free and fair elections in North Carolina and around the country, please make a donation of $30 or more today to help power this work.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/106519165/541770150/1925646595?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_AGNC_email_20250425-NDRC-Tier1-AGNCLiftnote_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20250425-NDRC-Tier1-AGNCLiftnote_&utm_campaign=AGNC&amount=30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjRlZTFlZjY1LTEyMjItZjAxMS04YjNkLTYwNDViZGVkOGNjYSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=yhrXaC7-aP-c1nukGuBDZGbwfjGnbqarzJtPVDkSlRw=) Thank you, Eric H. subject: Say NO to Medicaid cuts [Add your name]

body:
#
[](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/signup/medicaid_em_april25/?refcode=em250425-1-300&akid=5530%2E196590%2EQJ9MMb)
Team, Republicans in Congress have set their plans to cut funding for Medicaid in motion.
The Republican majority in the House recently passed a Senate-backed resolution, entirely on party lines, that would make major cuts to the federal budget when the final version is passed. Medicaid programs will almost certainly be on the list of programs losing funding.
And why do they need to cut the budget so much? **So they can pay for huge tax breaks for the top 0.1%.** We have to speak out against this.
[**Please, add your name to our petition calling on key members of Congress to oppose any and all cuts to Medicaid as they finalize this all-important budget.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/signup/medicaid_em_april25/?source=em250425-1-300&akid=5530%2E196590%2EQJ9MMb)
[SIGN ON NOW](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/signup/medicaid_em_april25/?source=em250425-1-300&akid=5530%2E196590%2EQJ9MMb)
Medicaid is a crucial program that helps millions of Americans afford the healthcare they need, including over 35 million kids under 18 who are on Medicaid or CHIP plans.
For many people a Medicaid plan is the difference between going bankrupt over medical bills and getting the care you need. For some folks, Medicaid coverage is the difference between life and death.
That’s why it’s an outrage that Republican leaders would push for huge cuts to Medicaid in order to pay for more tax cuts for billionaires. It’s an insult to the working class of America and sign of the growing power of the ultra-rich in our politics.
The truth is that if Medicaid cuts are made, people will suffer in every state and every Congressional district in this country. We have to make it clear to members of Congress that if they vote for this disastrous plan, they will be facing the consequences from voters of all backgrounds.
[**Add your name here and help us send an important message to Congress: Protect Medicaid or be prepared to be voted out of office. Every signature helps us show the unpopularity of these proposed cuts.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/signup/medicaid_em_april25/?source=em250425-1-300&akid=5530%2E196590%2EQJ9MMb)
[SIGN ON NOW](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/signup/medicaid_em_april25/?source=em250425-1-300&akid=5530%2E196590%2EQJ9MMb)
Thank you for your help,
The team at The Long Run

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a very important way we communicate with supporters like you. We'd hate to see you go, but if you'd like you can [**unsubscribe here**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe?t=1&akid=5530%2E196590%2EQJ9MMb). You can also [**sign up to receive fewer emails.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/signup/fewer-emails/?source=em-footer&t=2&akid=5530%2E196590%2EQJ9MMb)
The Long Run PAC is funded by grassroots donors giving what they can, when they can. [**Make a contribution to The Long Run PAC today.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/longrunpac-em-footer?refcode=em-footer&t=3&refcode2=5530_196590_QJ9MMb&akid=5530%2E196590%2EQJ9MMb)
Submit this form to [**update your contact information.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/signup/update-contact-info/?source=em-footer&t=4&akid=5530%2E196590%2EQJ9MMb)

body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMMP/1/92062/images/CER_logo_RGB%20%281%29.png]
Friend,
Contest Every Race just landed in Politico [https://www.politico.com/news/2025/04/24/dem-group-plans-12-million-investment-in-rural-areas-with-an-eye-toward-2028-00306758] - we don't usually seek out press, but right now we have an unbelievable opportunity to turn money into tanking Trump approval, increasing Dem approval and winning Congress in 2026.
Could you forward this email along to anyone you think might be interested in helping?
>From 2022-2024, we gave tiny grants and organizing support to hundreds of volunteer teams in exchange for them agreeing to meet monthly organizing goals and recruiting candidates. Outside auditors studied the work - we moved Harris vote share by a quarter point compared to counties we didn't operate in.
Now we're aiming to triple the size of the program and extend it for another half decade. But we need funding to do so.
Every $8,000 gets us another team in a battleground district working every month for the next two years to defeat Trumpism. But our program starts in May - we need to make decisions right now and we need the early pledges of money to accept the teams.
Could you help us spread the word by forwarding this to anyone that you know who could help?
In Solidarity,
Yoni Landau

# **Does your neck hurt from all that whiplash?**
On April 9th, markets threw a massive party - one of the biggest rallies since WWII.
Why? Trump paused some of the scariest tariff hikes for most countries. But on April 10th, markets plunged. Dow down nearly 1,000 points. Nasdaq tumbling.
Why? The China trade fight didn't pause - it escalated. _Badly**.**_
Tariffs on Chinese goods reportedly jumped to over 100%. China fired back with 84% tariffs on U.S. goods. The U.S. doubled down - raising tariffs to 125%.

"Evil has come to America. The present administration is engaged in barbarism...If the present administration chooses this course, then the questions of the day can be settled not with legislation, but with blood and iron. In short, we must decide when we must kill them. None of us wish for war, but if the present administration wishes to destroy the nation I would accept war rather than see it perish. I hope that you would choose the same."
Decker made it abundantly clear his desire to kill the MAGA movement goes beyond taking out President Donald Trump...

body:
|
#
---
Team, it’s Abigail Spanberger. I’m honored to share that I’m officially the Democratic nominee in the November 2025 election for the Governor’s office in Virginia! This race is personal to me. Let me explain why. Growing up, we moved around multiple times for my father’s job, but ultimately, we settled in Virginia. My parents — my father, a veteran and law enforcement officer, and my mother, a nurse — instilled in me a deep devotion to our country and an abiding commitment to service. I attended Henrico County Public Schools and went on to attend the University of Virginia. After graduation, I began my career as a federal law enforcement officer — working on money laundering cases and tracking narcotics traffickers with the U.S. Postal Inspection Service. I then joined the CIA as a case officer, where I worked undercover, collecting intelligence, managing assets, and overseeing high-profile programs to combat terrorism and keep Americans safe. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/106519826/541772372/289545884?refcode=AU_JC_FR_TAN_GEN_AC60_20250425_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODUyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzOTUyYjk3Yy0xNDIyLWYwMTEtOGIzZC02MDQ1YmRlZDhjY2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PKMsAjtb3-vLZcExahAnObWkzlxBgi1dmlqzFYHfWR4=) In 2014, Adam and I moved back to Henrico County, just miles from where we grew up, to raise our own children. I never thought I would one day run for elected office, but when I saw the division and dysfunction threatening our country after the 2016 election, I knew our country and Virginia’s 7th District deserved better. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/106519833/541772379/289545884?refcode=AU_JC_FR_TAN_GEN_AC60_20250425_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODUyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzOTUyYjk3Yy0xNDIyLWYwMTEtOGIzZC02MDQ1YmRlZDhjY2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PKMsAjtb3-vLZcExahAnObWkzlxBgi1dmlqzFYHfWR4=) In Congress, I worked every day to lower prescription drug costs, protect our democracy, support our veterans, defend our rights, and more. But now, Virginia is seeing dangerous and divisive rhetoric take over Richmond and drive extreme policies. I’m running for Governor, because I know we can do better – and I’m ready to bring my unwavering dedication to hard work and my commitment to uniting individuals to address the genuine issues affecting our Commonwealth. **[I hope you’ll split a donation between my campaign and Jason Crow today:](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/106519836/541772387/289545884?refcode=AU_JC_FR_TAN_GEN_AC60_20250425_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODUyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzOTUyYjk3Yy0xNDIyLWYwMTEtOGIzZC02MDQ1YmRlZDhjY2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PKMsAjtb3-vLZcExahAnObWkzlxBgi1dmlqzFYHfWR4=)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation to Abigail Spanberger and Jason Crow will go through immediately:_ | | [DONATE $10](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/106519837/541772388/289545884?amount=10&express_lane=true&refcode=AU_JC_FR_TAN_GEN_AC60_20250425_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODUyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzOTUyYjk3Yy0xNDIyLWYwMTEtOGIzZC02MDQ1YmRlZDhjY2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PKMsAjtb3-vLZcExahAnObWkzlxBgi1dmlqzFYHfWR4=)

This race is personal to me. Let me explain why. Growing up, we moved around multiple times for my father’s job, but ultimately, we settled in Virginia. My parents — my father, a veteran and law enforcement officer, and my mother, a nurse — instilled in me a deep devotion to our country and an abiding commitment to service. I attended Henrico County Public Schools and went on to attend the University of Virginia. After graduation, I began my career as a federal law enforcement officer — working on money laundering cases and tracking narcotics traffickers with the U.S. Postal Inspection Service. I then joined the CIA as a case officer, where I worked undercover, collecting intelligence, managing assets, and overseeing high-profile programs to combat terrorism and keep Americans safe. = In 2014, Adam and I moved back to Henrico County, just miles from where we grew up, to raise our own children. I never thought I would one day run for elected office, but when I saw the division and dysfunction threatening our country after the 2016 election, I knew our country and Virginia’s 7th District deserved better. = In Congress, I worked every day to lower prescription drug costs, protect our democracy, support our veterans, defend our rights, and more. But now, Virginia is seeing dangerous and divisive rhetoric take over Richmond and drive extreme policies. clean_body: | Friend, Last night, I joined Rachel Maddow to talk about mid-Michigan standing up to save Saginaw's Social Security office = | = Here’s what I told her: When the federal government – under pressure from billionaire Elon Musk – tried to sneak the Saginaw Social Security office onto a closure list, we didn’t wait around. We organized. We rallied. We fought back. And it worked. We got the administration to commit to not closing this crucial resource for our region. But let me be clear: this fight was never just about one building. It was about the people who rely on it every day to get their Social Security – seniors trying to access their benefits, veterans needing support, folks navigating disability claims. Here in mid-Michigan, 80% of jobs pay less than $50,000 a year. For families in our district, Social Security is their lifeline. Shutting down this office would’ve meant longer drives, longer wait times, more roadblocks, and ultimately, more people not getting the payments they rely on. We refused to let that happen – and because we stood together, we won. But now, the White House is lashing out. They called me a “no-name Congresswoman” and are trying to lie their way out of the mess they created. They can call me all the names and lie all they want, but I won’t back down. name: Jon Ossoff
subject: My decision…
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jon Ossoff for SenateThis email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail
body:
#

_Let me lay this out, clear as day:_
I am the only Democratic Senator up for re-election in a state Trump won in 2024.
And the President said he’ll back Marjorie Taylor Greene to challenge me.
This Senate race in Georgia will be the most competitive and most expensive in the nation.
If you’re outraged by what’s happening to our country — and you’re ready to fight –– please rush $5 to my re-election campaign today.
**Here’s the link to donate:**[**https://act.electjon.com/go/donate**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-apr25.X4JBIX&refcode=em250425-acq-hxtb-sp-8&t=1&akid=287%2E5691347%2EiOvk05)
Otherwise, let me remind you why I ran for Senate — and why this moment is just as urgent.
Before I was elected, I led investigations of corruption and human rights abuses worldwide. We exposed wrongdoing in countries where criticizing the government is dangerous, where whistleblowers and witnesses will only meet in secret, where protest carries the risk of prosecution.
More and more, the atmosphere under Trump reminded me of those places where dissent was silenced by intimidation.
Trump’s rise wasn’t just a crisis. It was a warning.
I ran for Senate because I saw the danger in electing someone so profoundly unfit for the presidency and I wanted to confront the corruption that made his rise possible.
I also ran — years before the Dobbs decision — because it was already clear the GOP was coming for reproductive rights. I saw Georgia as the front line in that fight. With a six-week ban now in place here, and Republicans pushing for a national abortion ban, it still is.
**Now this President is staging a power grab unprecedented in our history. In his first 100 days:**
* He’s freed violent criminals who attacked the Capitol on his behalf.
* Purged independent watchdogs across government.
* Stacked key agencies with loyalists—and called on them to investigate his political opponents.
* Defied and threatened federal judges.
* Undermined the press.
* Handed sweeping, unaccountable power to the billionaire who spent $300 million to elect him.

Trump’s goal isn’t just revenge. He wants to use the government to crush the opposition. And now, Americans are living in fear of their own government.
This is not a drill and it’s not a bad dream. As citizens, it is the test of our lifetimes.
**In 2020, the pundits said flipping a Republican Senate seat in Georgia couldn’t be done. But we built one of the strongest voter mobilization programs in Senate campaign history—and we won. That victory won the Senate majority.**
Now we must win again. And we _will_ win again.
Just like last time, I can’t do it alone.
So I’m asking:
[**Please make a contribution to my re-election campaign today, of $5 or any amount that works for you.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-apr25.X4JBIX&refcode=em250425-acq-hxtb-sp-8&t=2&akid=287%2E5691347%2EiOvk05)
The average online donation to our campaign is around $30. Many give less. Some give more.
All that matters is that lots and lots of people are contributing what they can to power our grassroots campaign. Please, contribute today.
**[CONTRIBUTE](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-apr25.X4JBIX&refcode=em250425-acq-hxtb-sp-8&t=3&akid=287%2E5691347%2EiOvk05)**
Thanks for being part of this team.
As always,
Jon Ossoff
[

subject: We will not be silenced. Not now. Not ever.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by The Pennsylvania Democratic Party
body:
Trump’s crackdown on political giving is a page from history’s darkest chapters. We’re fighting back.

| |

Peter, Let’s not mince words. **Donald Trump is laying the groundwork for fascism in plain sight — and daring us to look away.** Yesterday, his administration launched a formal attack on ActBlue — the grassroots platform used by millions of Americans to fund Democratic campaigns and progressive causes. **This isn’t about straw donations. It’s not about transparency. It’s about silencing dissent. It’s about criminalizing opposition. It’s about fear. And it’s a direct attack on the Constitution.** **Trump doesn’t want a fair fight — he wants total control. He’s not investigating every political platform. Just ours. Because we’re the ones standing in his way.** He’s already gone after **Immigrants**. **Trans people**. **Teachers**. **Scientists**. **Protesters**. **Journalists**. **Senior** **Citizens**. **Children**. **Veterans**. **Judges**. Now he’s selling “Trump 2028: Rewrite the Rules” merch — because in his mind, elections are already decided, rules are for suckers, and democracy is an inconvenience to be discarded. We’ve seen this movie before. It ends in silence, exile, prison, and worse — unless we stop it. **Trump’s biggest backer? A billionaire with multiple Nazi controversies under his belt. name: MassDems
subject: Trump, Musk, and the Truth About Social Security
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Massachusetts Democratic State Committee
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/Logo.png]
Peter,
Despite prior public assurances from President Donald Trump that Social Security will remain untouched, a series of statements, policy actions, and administrative changes under his influence - often amplified by Elon Musk and government agencies like the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) - paint a different picture. These actions have led to significant disruptions in the Social Security Administration (SSA), cuts in staffing and services, misleading claims, and harmful proposals that threaten the stability and accessibility of this vital program.
Key Claims and Actions from Trump, Musk, and DOGE
* Trump publicly stated he would not alter Social Security.

* Elon Musk referred to Social Security as a “Ponzi scheme.”

* Trump falsely claimed that over 6 million people aged 100+ are collecting Social Security benefits.

* DOGE falsely asserted that children are improperly collecting Social Security.

* Musk claimed over $500 billion in “wasteful” SSA spending , suggesting that program cuts wouldn’t harm actual beneficiaries.

* SSA has terminated 7,000 staff members and is planning further layoffs under orders from "U.S. DOGE Services" to meet Trump’s objective of shrinking federal agencies (per The Washington Post ).

* SSA announced the phase-out of phone support (as of April 14) for filing benefits or changing direct deposit information.

The Truth About Social Security and Its Beneficiaries
* More than 71 million people receive Social Security benefits.

* In Massachusetts alone, nearly 1.3 million residents depend on Social Security.

* Only about 89,000 people aged 99 and older are receiving legitimate benefits - nowhere near Trump’s exaggerated claim.

* The GAO (Government Accountability Office) found no evidence of widespread fraud or millions of dead people receiving benefits.

* Minor children of deceased or disabled Social Security beneficiaries may legally collect benefits until they reach adulthood.

* The SSA is funded by payroll taxes paid by both workers and employers - not through general government revenue.

* SSA staffing levels are currently at a 50-year low , resulting in longer lines and phone wait times, and widespread website outages are impacting people’s ability to file claims or access benefits.

* Roughly 40% of seniors rely on Social Security as their sole source of income .

* Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick , a billionaire, insulted beneficiaries by calling those who complain about delays “fraudsters.”

* Arizona Attorney General Kris Mayes has launched a special office to address Social Security-related issues.

* Senate Republicans blocked Senator Ed Markey’s amendment to protect Social Security’s phone service infrastructure.

* Constantly changing information and outages have created chaos and confusion for beneficiaries.

* According to Jim Roosevelt in the Boston Globe (March 31), these deliberate staff cuts and office closures “are intended to make it harder for people to get their earned benefits.”

Disturbing Developments Involving Immigrants and SSA Databases
* DOGE has mislabeled over 6,000 living immigrants as deceased , causing major financial and legal hardship.

* This includes loss of the ability to legally work, inability to receive benefits, blocked access to credit and banking systems that require an active Social Security number

* This directive reportedly came from the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) .

* The list of affected individuals has been added to the Social Security Death Master File , now renamed the “Ineligible File” by DOGE.

* DHS officials have openly stated that this move is designed to pressure immigrants to “self-deport.”

* When Greg Pearce , former SSA IT chief, resisted this illegal maneuver, he was escorted out of his office .

* Former Social Security Commissioner Martin O’Malley warns: “If they can, contrary to the law and every regulation and without any due process, mark people inside SSA’s database dead... then they can do that to anybody.”

subject: My roots in Virginia are generations deep
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP59/1/108618/images/Fy7yY0vXwAExUEj.jpeg]
Friend, did you know my roots in Virginia are generations deep?
My grandfather grew up in Norfolk, but left the Commonwealth to go to law school after facing discrimination. But he would return to pioneer as one of Virginia's first Black civil rights lawyers and fight for everyone to have a fair shot at the American Dream.
My father would join him by being in the first wave of students who helped integrate Norfolk's classrooms. He proved that when equal educational opportunities are made available, he could excel and eventually he would give back by serving in all three branches of government.
Now, I'm following in their footsteps by ensuring that Virginia embraces everyone. As a former delegate, I worked tirelessly to increase the minimum wage, keep illegal firearms off our streets, and expand Medicaid for working people and their families in the state.
And when I look at my sons and think of their futures, I keep my family’s legacy in mind, and I hope I can give them opportunities for a life even better than my own.
I’m proud of my legacy — it’s what is guiding me as I meet folks from all across the Commonwealth on the campaign trail.
I'm ready to join my family in serving Virginia as the commonwealth’s next Attorney General, but I can't do this alone. Will you donate $25 today so I can win this November and build the future for Virginia that our families deserve? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/loc_jones_em_q22025?amount=25]

| | | | | Dear ,
Thank you once again for your incredible support and hard work during the 2024 election for Pennsylvania State House District 28. Despite being outspent by more than 2.5 to 1—with over $700,000 spent against us—we prevailed. Every dollar and every hour you contributed was used strategically and effectively, exactly when and where it was needed.
Unfortunately, not all races across the Commonwealth saw the same outcome. Republicans fell just short of regaining control of the State House, with a current split of 102–101, leaving the balance of power hanging by a single vote.
With the House so closely divided, I’ve hit the ground running—pushing for legislation that cuts red tape and encourages growth, while standing strong against proposals that would mean massive tax hikes for Pennsylvanians.
In Harrisburg, I serve on four key committees: Commerce, Environmental Resources, State Government, and Housing & Community Development. I’ve also joined several bipartisan caucuses, including the Pennsylvania Competitiveness Caucus, which is focused on unlocking our state’s economic potential.
I truly believe Pennsylvania has everything it needs to become one of the fastest-growing, most dynamic states in the nation. But outdated regulations, a burdensome tax structure, and inefficient government continue to hold us back—we rank in the bottom 10 states for growth. That needs to change.
To keep up the fight, I need your continued support. Pennsylvania’s role as the largest swing state in the nation attracts enormous sums of out-of-state money from progressive organizations trying to influence our elections. I fully expect to be outspent again in 2026—but we will not be outworked. Just like in 2024, we’ll need a strong financial foundation to share our message and secure another victory.
I would be honored to have your continued backing as I work in Harrisburg to get Pennsylvania back on track. I also hope you’ll join us at our upcoming fundraiser on April 30th at Wildwood Country Club (details below).

Warm regards,

clean_body: | | | | | | | | | | | Dear , Thank you once again for your incredible support and hard work during the 2024 election for Pennsylvania State House District 28. Despite being outspent by more than 2.5 to 1—with over $700,000 spent against us—we prevailed. Every dollar and every hour you contributed was used strategically and effectively, exactly when and where it was needed. Unfortunately, not all races across the Commonwealth saw the same outcome. Republicans fell just short of regaining control of the State House, with a current split of 102–101, leaving the balance of power hanging by a single vote. With the House so closely divided, I’ve hit the ground running—pushing for legislation that cuts red tape and encourages growth, while standing strong against proposals that would mean massive tax hikes for Pennsylvanians. In Harrisburg, I serve on four key committees: Commerce, Environmental Resources, State Government, and Housing & Community Development. I’ve also joined several bipartisan caucuses, including the Pennsylvania Competitiveness Caucus, which is focused on unlocking our state’s economic potential. I truly believe Pennsylvania has everything it needs to become one of the fastest-growing, most dynamic states in the nation. But outdated regulations, a burdensome tax structure, and inefficient government continue to hold us back—we rank in the bottom 10 states for growth. That needs to change. To keep up the fight, I need your continued support. Pennsylvania’s role as the largest swing state in the nation attracts enormous sums of out-of-state money from progressive organizations trying to influence our elections. I fully expect to be outspent again in 2026—but we will not be outworked. Just like in 2024, we’ll need a strong financial foundation to share our message and secure another victory. I would be honored to have your continued backing as I work in Harrisburg to get Pennsylvania back on track. I also hope you’ll join us at our upcoming fundraiser on April 30th at Wildwood Country Club (details below). | Pennsylvania stands at a critical crossroads. Will we follow the path of high taxes and heavy regulation, like New York and California? Or will we choose the free-market, pro-growth approach that’s led states like Florida and Texas to thrive? With your help, I’ll keep fighting to make sure we choose the right path. **Governor Champions Bill to Cut Red Tape for Housing, Reduce Prices**
_“Families struggling with the high cost of housing are forced to make impossible choices – between staying in the communities they love and finding a place they can afford. This affordability crisis deepens our homelessness crisis,” Governor Kotek said. “It demands creative, practical solutions to increase the supply of homes quickly. We have to cut red tape and get out of our own way. Pre-approved building plans just makes sense.”_

_Governor Kotek emphasized the importance of meeting individuals where they are to transition them from homelessness to stable housing.
